achievements.description: Play a complete round with every class.
achievements.summary: Finish one whole round as each of the classes.

steps.text: Join @mechanic{Arena}, where rounds are short, and pick a class before the round starts.
Stay on that class until the round ends, then pick a class you have not used yet for the next round.
Keep going until every class has had one full round.

achievements.description: Play a complete game on 2Fort, Dustbowl, Granary, Gravel Pit, Hydro, and Well (CP).
achievements.summary: Finish one full game on each of Hydro, Well, Granary, Gravel Pit, Dustbowl, and 2Fort.

guide.context: Joining a game that is already running gives no credit for that map.

steps.text: Join a server that is on one of the six maps, and play until the game ends.
Repeat for every map you still need: @loc{Hydro}, @loc{Well} (Control Point version), @loc{Granary} (Control Point version), @loc{Gravel Pit}, @loc{Dustbowl} and @loc{2Fort}.

achievements.description: Accumulate 25000 heal points as a Medic.
achievements.summary: Heal a total of 25000 points while playing Medic.

steps.text: Play as @mechanic{Medic} and keep healing teammates until your total reaches 25000.

achievements.description: Set five enemies on fire in 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: Have five enemies burning from your attacks within a 30-second window.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Pyro} and attack a crowd of enemies, such as at the start of a round, until five of them are burning within 30 seconds.
If this is hard, ask a Medic to give you an @mechanic{ÜberCharge} for the attempt.

achievements.description: Accumulate 10 sentry gun kills with a single sentry.
achievements.summary: Get 10 kills with a single sentry gun.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Engineer} and build a @item{sentry gun} in a busy spot that enemies cannot easily shoot from far away, such as a courtyard on @loc{2Fort}.
Keep it alive by repairing it and by having teammates guard it against Spies.
If enemies are about to destroy it, pick it up and move it.

achievements.description: Get five revenge kills.
achievements.summary: Get five revenge kills.

steps.text: Play until an enemy dominates you, then pick a class that works well against that enemy's favorite class and kill that enemy.
Repeat until you have five revenge kills.

achievements.description: Get five kills in a row without dying.
achievements.summary: Kill five enemies back to back in one life.

steps.text: Play a strong fighting class such as @mechanic{Heavy}, or defend as @mechanic{Engineer}, and stay alive while you get five kills.

achievements.description: Trick an opposing Medic into healing you.
achievements.summary: Trick an enemy Medic into healing you.

guide.context: This works only as @mechanic{Spy}, unless auto-balance moves you to the other team while a friendly Medic is healing you.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Spy} and disguise as a member of the enemy team.
Act like an enemy and change your disguised weapon often, then stand near an enemy Medic until the Medic heals you.

achievements.description: Play in a game with five or more players from your Friends list.
achievements.summary: Play a full round in a game with at least five players from your Steam Friends list.

steps.text: Ask five or more Steam friends to join the same server as you.
Play a full round together, from start to end, with all five friends in the game the whole time.

achievements.description: Win 20 games.
achievements.summary: Win 20 games.

steps.text: Keep playing and winning games until you have 20 wins.
@mechanic{Medieval Mode} and @mechanic{Versus Saxton Hale} games are brief, so wins come faster there.

achievements.description: Accumulate 1000 total kills.
achievements.summary: Get 1000 total kills.

steps.text: Play offensive classes such as @mechanic{Soldier} or @mechanic{Pyro} until you reach 1000 kills.

achievements.description: Get 25 headshots as a Sniper.
achievements.summary: Get 25 headshots as a Sniper.

guide.context: Headshots with the Spy's @item{Ambassador} and with a Huntsman arrow reflected by a Pyro also count.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Sniper} on a map with long sight lines, such as @loc{2Fort} or @loc{Double Cross}, and shoot from a spot where few enemies can reach you.
Aim for the heads of slow targets such as Heavies and Soldiers until you reach 25 headshots.

achievements.description: Play a full round without killing any enemies, and score the highest on a team of 6 or more players.
achievements.summary: As a Medic, finish a full round with the highest score on a team of at least 6 players without killing any enemy.

guide.context: You may get kills as another class first. After you switch to Medic, do not kill anyone until the round ends.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Medic} in a round where your side has 6 or more players, and do not kill any enemy after you switch to Medic.
Heal everyone and deploy your @mechanic{ÜberCharge} when needed. Most of your points will come from assists.
Spread your healing so no teammate gets far ahead of you on the scoreboard. Make sure you have the top score when the round ends.

achievements.description: Heal a teammate who's taking fire from 4 enemies at once.
achievements.summary: Heal a teammate who is being shot by 4 enemies at once.

steps.text: Heal a teammate on the front line, where enemies focus their fire, and keep healing while 4 enemies attack that teammate.
Keep an @mechanic{ÜberCharge} ready in case you are both overwhelmed.

achievements.description: Work with 2 other Medics to deploy 3 simultaneous ÜberCharges.
achievements.summary: Deploy 3 ÜberCharges simultaneously by teaming up with 2 other Medics.

guide.context: The other Medics can be on either team.

steps.text: Ask two other Medics to try this with you, ideally in the setup phase at the start of a match, when all three of you have time to fill your ÜberCharge meters.
Fill your meters, then deploy all three ÜberCharges at the same time.

achievements.description: Have an ÜberCharge ready before the Setup phase ends.
achievements.summary: Fill your ÜberCharge meter before the setup phase is over.

steps.text: Join a map with a setup phase and play as @mechanic{Medic}.
Heal a teammate during setup until your ÜberCharge meter is full.

achievements.description: Deploy 3 ÜberCharges in less than 5 minutes, and assist in 5 kills during that time.
achievements.summary: Use 3 ÜberCharges in under 5 minutes while also assisting in 5 kills.

steps.text: Stay at the back of large fights and heal teammates, especially hurt ones, so your ÜberCharge fills fast.
Use 3 ÜberCharges within 5 minutes and help your team score 5 kills in that span.
The @item{Vaccinator}, @item{Quick-Fix} and @item{Ubersaw} build ÜberCharge quickly.

achievements.description: Deploy an ÜberCharge within 8 seconds of a nearby enemy Medic deploying his.
achievements.summary: Use your ÜberCharge no more than 8 seconds after a close-by enemy Medic uses theirs.

guide.context: A standard ÜberCharge wins against a Kritzkrieg or Quick-Fix ÜberCharge, so it is best to use the standard one.

steps.text: Wait until a nearby enemy Medic deploys an @mechanic{ÜberCharge}, then deploy yours within 8 seconds. This is easiest when your team is defending.

achievements.description: In a team with no Medics, be the first person to switch to Medic after a teammate calls for 'Medic!', and then heal 500 health.
achievements.summary: With no Medic on your team, switch to Medic before anyone else when a teammate calls for one, then heal 500 health.

guide.context: The achievement is awarded only after the round ends or you die.

steps.text: Wait until your team has no Medic and a teammate calls for 'Medic!'.
Switch to @mechanic{Medic} before anyone else does, then heal 500 health in total.
Finish the round or die to receive the achievement.

achievements.description: Deploy an ÜberCharge on a teammate less than a second before they're hit by a critical explosive.
achievements.summary: Use your ÜberCharge on a teammate within one second before a critical explosive hits that teammate.

guide.context: It also counts when the target is a Demoman or Soldier whose own critical projectile hits them.

steps.text: Watch for a critical rocket or grenade heading for a teammate.
Deploy your @mechanic{ÜberCharge} on that teammate just before it hits.

achievements.description: Block the enemy from capturing a control point with an ÜberCharged teammate.
achievements.summary: As a Medic, stop an enemy capture of a control point while your ÜberCharged teammate defends it.

steps.text: Stand on a control point with your teammate while an enemy is capturing it.
Deploy your @mechanic{ÜberCharge} so the enemy capture is stopped.

achievements.description: Assist a fellow Medic in killing 3 enemies in a single life.
achievements.summary: Help another Medic get 3 kills during one life.

guide.context: It does not matter who heals and who kills.

steps.text: Team up with another Medic and fight weaker enemies together.
Use your ÜberCharge if needed, and stay alive until 3 enemies have died.

achievements.displayName: Does It Hurt When I Do This?
achievements.description: Kill 50 Scouts with your syringe gun.
achievements.summary: Get 50 kills on Scouts using a Medic's Syringe Gun.

guide.context: Kills with the @item{Crusader's Crossbow} do not count.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Medic} with a @item{Syringe Gun} or @item{Blutsauger} and shoot Scouts who attack you.
Aim ahead of fast Scouts. If no teammates are near, walk backward while firing.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Medics with your bone saw.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Medics with your Bonesaw.

steps.text: Attack enemy Medics with your @item{Bonesaw} when no teammates are nearby.

achievements.description: Assist a Heavy in killing 10 enemies, where neither of you die.
achievements.summary: Help a Heavy kill 10 enemies while both of you stay alive.

guide.context: This overlaps with the Heavy achievement Division of Labor.

steps.text: Pair up with a good Heavy and use voice chat to coordinate.
Play carefully, use cover, and watch for ambushes. Keep your ÜberCharge for emergencies.

achievements.description: Assist in killing 3 enemies with a single ÜberCharge on a Scout.
achievements.summary: Help a Scout kill 3 enemies during one ÜberCharge on that Scout.

guide.context: This overlaps with the Scout achievement Doctoring the Ball.

steps.text: Pair up with a Scout who uses a @item{Scattergun} or @item{Shortstop}, so there is less reloading.
Use a @item{Kritzkrieg} on the Scout, or use a standard ÜberCharge while the Scout uses @item{Crit-a-Cola}.
Have the Scout kill 3 enemies before the ÜberCharge ends.

achievements.description: Assist in burning 5 enemies with a single ÜberCharge on a Pyro.
achievements.summary: Help a Pyro ignite 5 enemies during one ÜberCharge on that Pyro.

steps.text: Find a Pyro who will cooperate and attack a tight group of enemies, such as at a control point or at the start of a round.
Deploy your @mechanic{ÜberCharge} on that Pyro and have them set 5 enemies on fire.

achievements.description: Assist in punching 2 enemies with a single ÜberCharge on a Heavy.
achievements.summary: Help a Heavy punch 2 enemies during one ÜberCharge on that Heavy.

guide.context: The Heavy only has to punch the enemies, not kill them.

steps.text: Find a Heavy who will work with you and deploy your @mechanic{ÜberCharge} on them.
Have the Heavy punch 2 enemies with a melee weapon before the ÜberCharge ends.

achievements.description: Assist in destroying 5 enemy Engineer buildings with a single ÜberCharge on a Demoman.
achievements.summary: Help a Demoman destroy 5 enemy Engineer buildings during one ÜberCharge on that Demoman.

guide.context: This overlaps with the Demoman achievement Tam O'Shatter. An ÜberCharge lasts only eight seconds, so find the buildings before you deploy it.

steps.text: Pair up with a Demoman and find a place with at least 5 enemy buildings close together.
Deploy your standard @mechanic{ÜberCharge} on the Demoman and run in front of them to draw @item{sentry gun} fire.
Have the Demoman destroy 5 buildings before the ÜberCharge ends.

achievements.description: Heal an Engineer as he repairs his sentry gun while it's under enemy fire.
achievements.summary: Keep an Engineer healed while he repairs his sentry gun under enemy fire.

guide.context: This overlaps with the Engineer achievement Doc, Stock, and Barrel.

steps.text: Find an Engineer who is defending a @item{sentry gun} and heal them while they repair it under enemy fire.

achievements.description: Assist in killing 3 enemies on an enemy control point, in a single life.
achievements.summary: Help kill 3 enemies while you are on an enemy control point, without dying in between.

steps.text: Stand on an enemy @mechanic{control point} with a strong teammate nearby, and help kill 3 enemies there before you die.
Keep your ÜberCharge ready in case you are overwhelmed.

achievements.description: Heal 200 teammates after they've called for 'Medic!'.
achievements.summary: Heal 200 teammates after they have called for a Medic.

steps.text: Stay near fights as a @mechanic{Medic} and heal each teammate who calls for 'Medic!' until you reach 200.

achievements.description: Win 2Fort with a shutout.
achievements.summary: Win 2Fort without the enemy team capturing your intelligence.

steps.text: Join a game on @loc{2Fort}. Build a strong defense early, for example by playing @mechanic{Engineer}, so the enemy never scores.
Push as a team to take the enemy intelligence until your team wins the game.

achievements.description: Win Well in 5 minutes or less.
achievements.summary: Win Well (Control Point) in 5 minutes or less.

steps.text: Join a game on @loc{Well} and push with your team to take all points as fast as you can, aiming to win in 5 minutes or less.

achievements.description: Win Hydro without giving up a capture.
achievements.summary: Win Hydro while the enemy team captures nothing.

steps.text: Join a game on @loc{Hydro} and work as a team to take each point quickly so the enemy never captures one, until you win.

achievements.description: Successfully defend Dustbowl without giving up a capture.
achievements.summary: Hold Dustbowl as the defenders so the attackers never capture a point.

steps.text: Join a game on @loc{Dustbowl} on the defending team and play a defensive class such as @mechanic{Engineer}, @mechanic{Heavy} or @mechanic{Demoman}.
Hold the first point against the attackers, who are close to it when the round starts, and keep every point until time runs out.

achievements.description: Successfully defend Gravel Pit without giving up a capture.
achievements.summary: Hold Gravel Pit as the defenders so the attackers never capture a point.

steps.text: Join a game on @loc{Gravel Pit} on the defending team.
Build @item{sentry guns} at point A and point B, and keep attacking classes near both.
Use voice chat to keep both points covered until time runs out.

achievements.description: Extinguish 100 burning teammates.
achievements.summary: Extinguish 100 burning teammates.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Medic}, heal teammates who are on fire before anyone else until you have extinguished 100.

achievements.description: Assist in killing 20 nemeses.
achievements.summary: Assist in killing 20 nemeses.

guide.context: Helping kill your own nemesis counts too.

steps.text: Heal your teammates while they fight, and keep healing those who take revenge on their nemeses.
A nemesis kill is when a teammate kills the enemy who keeps killing them. Help with 20 of these.

achievements.description: Kill 2 enemies in a single life, while having your ÜberCharge ready, but undeployed.
achievements.summary: Get 2 kills in one life while holding a full, unused ÜberCharge.

steps.text: Fill your ÜberCharge meter and hold it without using it.
Play carefully and attack only weak or distracted enemies until you have 2 kills in that life.
If it is hard, have another Medic heal you while you fight.

achievements.description: Hit enemies with your bonesaw 5 times in a row without dying or missing.
achievements.summary: Land 5 Bonesaw hits in a row, with no misses and no deaths in between.

guide.context: The hits do not need to be quick, but do not switch weapons, because that resets progress.

steps.text: Fight close-range enemies with your @item{Bonesaw}, using your higher speed and health regeneration to win.
Do not miss, die or change weapons until you have hit 5 times.

achievements.description: Accumulate 7000 heal points in a single life.
achievements.summary: Earn 7000 heal points within one life.

guide.context: The achievement is awarded after the round ends or you die. Overhealing counts.

steps.text: Stay behind your team in fights and heal constantly, without taking risks.
Do not follow a Medic buddy on suicide runs. Keep your ÜberCharge for emergencies.
Press Tab to check your healing total, because you get no progress messages.

achievements.description: Accumulate 10000 heal points health in a single life.
achievements.summary: Earn 10000 heal points within one life.

guide.context: The achievement is awarded after the round ends or you die.

steps.text: Use the same careful play as for 7000 points: stay at the back, heal constantly and survive.
Keep going until you reach 10000 points in one life.

achievements.description: Accumulate 1 million total heal points.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 1 million total heal points.

guide.context: Healing from the @item{Medi Gun}, @item{Kritzkrieg}, @item{Quick-Fix}, @item{Vaccinator}, @item{Crusader's Crossbow} and @item{Amputator} all counts.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Medic} and heal teammates until your total reaches 1 million.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy Spy that you have been healing.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy Spy after healing that Spy.

steps.text: Heal a disguised Spy you suspect is an enemy, then kill that Spy with any weapon.

achievements.description: Save a falling teammate from dying on impact.
achievements.summary: Keep a falling teammate alive so the landing does not kill them.

steps.text: When an explosion throws a teammate into the air, aim your @item{Medi Gun} at that teammate and keep healing until they land alive.

achievements.description: ÜberCharge 2 teammates at once.
achievements.summary: ÜberCharge 2 teammates at once.

guide.context: This is easiest in the setup phase, when ÜberCharge builds fast and the team stays in a small area.

steps.text: Deploy your ÜberCharge, then switch quickly between two teammates so both stay invulnerable.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy with a freezecam shot of you taunting above their ragdoll.
achievements.summary: Taunt over an enemy's ragdoll so their freezecam shows you doing it.

steps.text: Kill an enemy, then taunt right away over their body so they see you in their freezecam.

achievements.description: Use your bonesaw to kill a spy who has been calling for 'Medic!'.
achievements.summary: Kill a Spy with your Bonesaw after that Spy called for a Medic.

steps.text: Watch for a player who calls for a Medic and acts suspiciously, and confirm they are a Spy before you attack.
If you are sure one is a Spy, hit them with your @item{Bonesaw} until they die.

achievements.description: ÜberCharge 5 of your Steam Community Friends.
achievements.summary: ÜberCharge 5 different Steam Community friends.

guide.context: Charging the same friend more than once counts only once.

steps.text: Enter a server your friend is on and use your ÜberCharge on that friend.
Repeat with four more friends.

achievements.description: Join a game that one of your friends is in and then deploy an ÜberCharge on him.
achievements.summary: Join a game that a Steam friend is in, then deploy an ÜberCharge on that friend.

guide.context: Do not die before you ÜberCharge your friend.

steps.text: Use Join Game from your friend's entry in your Steam friends list to join their game.
Play as @mechanic{Medic} and deploy an ÜberCharge on your friend.

achievements.description: Be healing a teammate as he achieves an achievement of his own.
achievements.summary: Be healing a teammate at the moment that teammate earns an achievement.

guide.context: Healing an enemy Spy when they earn an achievement does not count.

steps.text: Keep healing teammates while you play as @mechanic{Medic}. Eventually one of them will earn an achievement while you are healing them.

achievements.description: Assist in exploding 5 enemies with a single ÜberCharge on a Soldier.
achievements.summary: As Medic, help a Soldier blow up 5 enemies during a single ÜberCharge on that Soldier.

guide.context: The Soldier earns their own matching achievement from the same kills.

steps.text: Team up with a Soldier who uses the standard @item{Rocket Launcher}.
Heal the Soldier with your @item{Kritzkrieg} until your ÜberCharge is ready.
Use the ÜberCharge on the Soldier when enemies are bunched together, and keep healing until 5 enemies are blown up.
steps.note: Groups of enemies form near control points and when a round begins.

achievements.description: Achieve 10 of the achievements in the Medic pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 10 achievements in the Medic pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Medic do not count.

steps.text: Earn Medic pack achievements until you have 10.

achievements.description: Achieve 16 of the achievements in the Medic pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 16 achievements in the Medic pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Medic pack achievements until you have 16.

achievements.description: Achieve 22 of the achievements in the Medic pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 22 achievements in the Medic pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Medic pack achievements until you have 22.

achievements.description: Use your shotgun to finish off 20 players you've ignited.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 players you have set on fire by landing the final hit with your Shotgun.

steps.text: Ignite an enemy with your @item{Flame Thrower}.
When the enemy backs out of flame range, switch to your Shotgun and finish them.
steps.note: An airblast that pushes an enemy into a wall makes the Shotgun shot easy. The Degreaser, Reserve Shooter and Panic Attack switch weapons faster.

achievements.description: Have 2 enemy Scouts on fire at the same time.
achievements.summary: Make 2 enemy Scouts burn together.

steps.text: Hold a chokepoint when the enemy team has several @enemy{Scout}s.
Ignite two Scouts so both are still burning together.

achievements.description: Force 10 burning enemies to jump into water.
achievements.summary: Make 10 burning enemies leap into water to put out the fire.

guide.context: Very shallow water, like the Hydro rivers, does not put out fire, so pick deeper water.

steps.text: Ignite enemies on a map with deep water close by.
Let them run to the water to put themselves out, or blast them in.

achievements.description: Kill 15 players while you're dead.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 players while you are dead.

steps.text: Set enemies on fire and deal as much damage as you can before you die.
steps.note: Afterburn finishes them while you are dead.

steps.text: Take nearby med kits so enemies cannot put themselves out.

achievements.description: Ignite 5 Spies who have a sapper on a friendly building.
achievements.summary: Ignite 5 enemy Spies who have a sapper on one of your team's buildings.

steps.text: Guard your team's Engineer buildings.
When a sentry gun is being sapped, flame nearby teammates to find the Spy, then ignite the Spy.

achievements.description: Ignite 5 enemies carrying your intelligence.
achievements.summary: Ignite 5 enemies who are carrying your team's intelligence.

steps.text: Play a mode that has an intelligence and guard it.
Ignite each enemy who picks it up.
steps.note: Enemy Scouts rush the intelligence at the start of a round, which is a good time to wait near it.

achievements.description: Ignite 10 cloaked Spies.
achievements.summary: Ignite 10 cloaked enemy Spies.

steps.text: Watch for the smoke and shimmer that a cloaked Spy leaves.
Puff flames into corners and recesses to find hidden Spies, and ignite each one.

achievements.description: Ignite 10 enemies that have recently used a teleporter.
achievements.summary: Ignite 10 enemies who have just used a teleporter.

steps.text: Follow the trail players leave to find the enemy Teleporter.
Leave the Teleporter Exit standing, wait beside it, and ignite whoever arrives.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies in a row, all within the same area.
achievements.summary: Get 3 kills in a row, all inside one area of the map.

steps.text: Ambush enemies gathered in a busy spot, such as a control point.
steps.note: The kills have no time limit, so you can retreat and come back.

achievements.description: Kill 3 people with your axe in one life.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies with your melee weapon in one life.

guide.context: It may be easier in Medieval Mode or Mannpower.

steps.text: Wear an enemy down with your Flame Thrower or Shotgun if you like, but land the final hit with your melee weapon.
steps.note: Igniting an enemy and then hitting with the Axtinguisher mini-crit kills fastest. An airblast can push enemies into easy spots.

steps.text: Retreat when your health gets low so you stay alive for all 3 kills.

achievements.description: Kill 6 people with your axe in one life.
achievements.summary: Kill 6 enemies with your melee weapon in one life.

guide.context: It may be easier in Medieval Mode or Mannpower.

steps.text: Wear enemies down with other weapons if you like, but land each final hit with your melee weapon.
Pick off lone enemies such as @enemy{Sniper}s and @enemy{Spy}s, and stay away from @enemy{Heavy}s.

achievements.description: Ignite 10 disguised Spies.
achievements.summary: Ignite 10 disguised enemy Spies.

steps.text: Flame suspicious teammates to test whether they are Spies.
steps.note: A teammate who burns is a disguised enemy Spy.

achievements.description: Ignite 10 Snipers while they are zoomed in.
achievements.summary: Ignite 10 enemy Snipers while they are zoomed in.

steps.text: Take less-used paths to reach where enemy Snipers perch.
Ignite each scoped Sniper up close, or from range with a flare weapon such as the Flare Gun or Manmelter.

achievements.description: Ignite 3 Medics that are ready to deploy an ÜberCharge.
achievements.summary: Ignite 3 enemy Medics whose ÜberCharge is ready to use.

steps.text: Reach the enemy Medic by an alternate route so they do not see you coming.
steps.note: A Medic who sees you will often use the ÜberCharge, which wastes the attempt.

steps.text: Ignite the Medic up close, or from range with a flare weapon such as the Flare Gun or Manmelter.

achievements.description: Kill 50 Heavies with your flamethrower.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemy Heavies with the standard Flame Thrower.

guide.context: Only the standard Flame Thrower counts. Weapons such as the Rainblower and Nostromo Napalmer do not.

steps.text: Switch to the standard Flame Thrower.
Ambush enemy Heavies or attack them with teammates, and circle-strafe to take less damage.
steps.note: A Heavy's Minigun shreds you at close range.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies while you're both underwater.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies while you and they are both underwater.

guide.context: Your primary weapons do no damage underwater, so use your Shotgun or melee weapon.

steps.text: Wait near water for hurt enemies that retreat into it.
Follow them in and finish them with your Shotgun or Fire Axe.
steps.note: The Neon Annihilator always crits underwater targets.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies in a single ÜberCharge.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies during a single ÜberCharge.

guide.context: A normal ÜberCharge is the best choice, because you fight up close and draw fire.

steps.text: Ask a friendly Medic to ÜberCharge you.
Rush a group of enemies and kill 3 before the ÜberCharge ends.

achievements.description: Destroy 50 Engineer buildings.
achievements.summary: Destroy 50 Engineer buildings.

steps.text: Burn down unguarded Dispensers and Teleporters.
Avoid a level 3 sentry gun unless you have an ÜberCharge.
steps.note: You cannot circle-strafe a level 3 sentry gun. Dragon's Fury does 75 damage to buildings at any range, and the Homewrecker destroying an Electro Sapper also counts.

achievements.description: Ignite 50 enemies capturing one of your control points.
achievements.summary: Ignite 50 enemies who are capturing one of your team's control points.

steps.text: Stay near your control points and ignite any enemy who tries to capture them.
Pester approaching enemies with a flare weapon such as the Flare Gun or Manmelter.

achievements.description: Kill 500 enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 enemies as Pyro.

steps.text: Play as Pyro and keep getting kills until you reach 500.

achievements.description: Do 1 million points of total fire damage.
achievements.summary: Do 1 million points of fire damage.

guide.context: Only fire damage counts. Shotgun and melee damage do not.

steps.text: Play as Pyro and burn enemies until your total fire damage reaches 1 million.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a taunt.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with one of your taunts.

steps.text: Find an enemy who is not paying attention, such as a Sniper who is scoped in.
Taunt with a secondary weapon other than the Scorch Shot.
steps.note: The Pyro is noisy before the taunt lands. You can also taunt out of view, for example behind a corner or beside a Teleporter Exit, and catch enemies walking by.

achievements.description: Ignite an enemy Spy while he's flicking a cigarette.
achievements.summary: Ignite an enemy Spy while he is flicking a cigarette.

steps.text: Find an enemy Spy who is taunting with his Disguise Kit out.
steps.note: Enemy Spies rarely taunt like this. One working on the For Your Eyes Only achievement may do it.

steps.text: Ignite the Spy while he flicks the cigarette, from range with a flare weapon if needed.

achievements.description: Cause a dominated player to leave the server.
achievements.summary: Cause a player you dominate to leave the server while you are playing Pyro.

steps.text: Dominate a player. You can do this as any class.
Switch to Pyro before they leave and stay on that server until they quit.
steps.note: Retreat or bring teammates if the player gets the upper hand, so they do not take revenge.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies while they're taunting.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies while they are taunting.

steps.text: Attack enemies who are taunting.
steps.note: A Heavy who is eating a Sandvich or other lunchbox item counts as taunting.

achievements.description: Ignite a rocket-jumping Soldier while he's in midair.
achievements.summary: Ignite an enemy Soldier while he is rocket-jumping in midair.

steps.text: Shoot the airborne Soldier with a flare weapon such as the Flare Gun or Manmelter.
steps.note: A rocket-jumping Soldier is usually out of Flame Thrower reach. As Soldier, a Cow Mangler 5000 charged shot also works because its explosion ignites everyone it hits.

achievements.description: Provide enemies with freezecam shots of each of your taunts.
achievements.summary: Show enemies freezecam shots of your taunt with your primary, secondary and melee weapons.

steps.text: Kill an enemy with your primary weapon and taunt right away.
Do the same with your secondary weapon.
Do the same with your melee weapon.
steps.note: The three taunts do not need to be in one life or against one player.

achievements.description: Ignite an enemy, and the Medic healing him.
achievements.summary: Ignite an enemy and the Medic who is healing him.

steps.text: Take another route to ambush the Medic and patient from behind.
Ignite both of them.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with your flamethrower, from behind.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with your Flame Thrower while hitting them from behind.

steps.text: Surprise enemies, then circle-strafe around to their backs as they turn toward you.
steps.note: The Backburner always crits from behind.

achievements.description: Kill a burning enemy who was ignited by another Pyro.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy who is burning from another Pyro's fire.

steps.text: Look for an enemy that a friendly Pyro has set on fire.
Finish that enemy with any weapon.

achievements.description: Kill a Soldier with a reflected critical rocket.
achievements.summary: Kill a Soldier with a rocket that you reflected.

steps.text: Wait for an enemy Soldier to fire a rocket at you.
Airblast the rocket back so it kills the Soldier.
steps.note: Every reflected rocket mini-crits, so any reflected rocket kill counts.

achievements.description: Kill 1000 enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill 1000 enemies as Pyro.

steps.text: Play as Pyro and keep getting kills until you reach 1000.

achievements.description: Ignite 100 enemies with the flare gun.
achievements.summary: Set 100 enemies on fire using the Flare Gun.

steps.text: Shoot enemies from range with the Flare Gun, Detonator or Scorch Shot.
steps.note: Flares fly in an arc, so aim above the target. Pyros do not ignite, so shots at them do not count.

achievements.description: Reflect 100 projectiles with your compressed air blast.
achievements.summary: Reflect 100 projectiles with your airblast.

steps.text: Airblast incoming projectiles back at enemies until you reach 100.
steps.note: Stickybomb carpets from a Demoman are easy targets and can be reflected more than once. Rockets, grenades, arrows, Sandman balls, Wrap Assassin baubles, Mad Milk, Jarate, flares and sentry gun rockets all count.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy in the same second that he kills you.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy within one second of dying to him.

steps.text: Fight enemies up close so that you set them on fire before they kill you.
steps.note: The afterburn can finish them just after you die.

achievements.description: Achieve 10 of the achievements in the Pyro pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 10 achievements in the Pyro pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Pyro do not count.

steps.text: Earn Pyro pack achievements until you have 10.

achievements.description: Achieve 16 of the achievements in the Pyro pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 16 achievements in the Pyro pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Pyro pack achievements until you have 16.

achievements.description: Achieve 22 of the achievements in the Pyro pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 22 achievements in the Pyro pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Pyro pack achievements until you have 22.

achievements.description: Achieve 10 of the achievements in the Heavy pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 10 achievements in the Heavy pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Heavy do not count.

steps.text: Earn Heavy pack achievements until you have 10.

achievements.description: Achieve 16 of the achievements in the Heavy pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 16 achievements in the Heavy pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Heavy pack achievements until you have 16.

achievements.description: Achieve 22 of the achievements in the Heavy pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 22 achievements in the Heavy pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Heavy pack achievements until you have 22.

achievements.description: Take 1000 points of damage in a single life.
achievements.summary: Take 1000 damage during one life.

steps.text: Stay at the front line with a Medic healing you until you have taken 1000 damage in one life.
steps.note: Damage beyond your remaining health, such as from a backstab, still counts.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies within 3 seconds of them attacking your Medic.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies no more than 3 seconds after they hit your Medic.

steps.text: Stay close to your Medic.
Kill each enemy who hits your Medic within 3 seconds of the attack.
steps.note: Medics are often the most targeted teammate, so stopping attackers early also keeps them alive.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with a Medic assisting you, where neither of you die.
achievements.summary: Get 10 kills with a Medic helping, while both you and the Medic stay alive.

guide.context: The Medic's matching achievement is Big Pharma, so you both can earn it from the same kills.

steps.text: Team up with a Medic, using voice chat.
Play carefully and give your Medic your Sandvich if they need health.
If you can, keep an ÜberCharge ready for emergencies.

achievements.description: Earn a domination for a Medic who's healing you.
achievements.summary: Earn a domination for the Medic who is healing you.

steps.text: Fight alongside a Medic who is healing you so that the Medic gets a domination.
Keep the Medic alive, since dying loses their domination progress.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a taunt.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a taunt.

steps.text: Find an enemy who is not paying attention, such as a scoped Sniper.
Use the Fists' High Noon taunt on them.
steps.note: Hitting an enemy in the back with the Holiday Punch also gives you plenty of time to kill them.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies carrying your intelligence.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies who are carrying your team's intelligence.

steps.text: Play a mode that has an intelligence.
When an enemy takes it, use the intelligence compass to find and cut off the carrier.
steps.note: Natascha slows the runner, and the Tomislav helps you get shots off.

achievements.description: Work with a friendly Medic to kill an enemy Heavy & Medic pair.
achievements.summary: With a friendly Medic, kill an enemy Heavy and the Medic who is healing him.

steps.text: Team up with a Medic.
Ambush the enemy pair, or have your Medic use an ÜberCharge.
Kill the enemy Heavy first, then the Medic as he runs.
steps.note: The standard Minigun or the Brass Beast does the most damage to another Heavy.

achievements.description: While invulnerable and on defense, block an invulnerable enemy Heavy's movement.
achievements.summary: While ÜberCharged and defending, block the movement of an ÜberCharged enemy Heavy.

steps.text: Ask your Medic for an @mechanic{ÜberCharge} when an ÜberCharged enemy @enemy{Heavy} pushes toward your defense.
Stand in front of that Heavy in a chokepoint so he cannot move forward.

achievements.description: Block the enemy from moving the payload cart 25 times.
achievements.summary: Keep the enemy team's payload cart from advancing, 25 separate times.

steps.text: Play defense on a payload map.
Ambush players who push the cart and rev your @item{Minigun} before they react.

achievements.description: Get ÜberCharged 50 times.
achievements.summary: Get ÜberCharged by a Medic 50 times.

guide.context: Respawning in Mannpower also counts as an ÜberCharge.

steps.text: Stay close to a friendly @mechanic{Medic} so he picks you for his @mechanic{ÜberCharge}.
Lead your team's push while you are charged.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies while being recharged by a dispenser.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies while a Dispenser is recharging you.

guide.context: Kills while pushing a payload cart count, because the cart works as a mobile level 1 Dispenser.

steps.text: Ask an @mechanic{Engineer} to build a @item{Dispenser} near a chokepoint.
Stay beside the Dispenser and kill enemies who come at you.

achievements.description: Get 25 enemy kills where you either assist or are assisted by another Heavy.
achievements.summary: Earn 25 kills that involve a second Heavy on your team, either as your assist or as the killer you assist.

steps.text: Play beside a friendly @mechanic{Heavy} and shoot the same targets.

achievements.description: Remove 20 stickybombs by killing the Demomen who produced them.
achievements.summary: Kill the Demomen who laid 20 stickybombs, which removes those bombs.

steps.text: Get close to Demomen who have stickybombs out and kill them. Each death removes all of that Demoman's active stickybombs.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies while both you and your victim are underwater.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies in deep water while you are submerged too.

guide.context: Knockback that pushes an enemy out of the water near the surface makes that kill not count.

steps.text: Play a map with deep water, such as Aquarius, 2Fort or Well.
Follow enemies who flee into the water and kill them while you are both under water. Your @item{Shotgun} does not slow you down like the Minigun.

achievements.description: In a single life, get shot, burned, bludgeoned, and receive explosive damage.
achievements.summary: Within one life, take damage from bullets, fire, a melee weapon and an explosion.

steps.text: Stay on the front line with a Medic close by. The @item{Sandvich} and @item{Fists of Steel} help you survive.
Before you die, take a hit from a hitscan weapon such as a Sniper Rifle or Shotgun, burning from a Pyro, a melee hit, and explosive damage from a Rocket Launcher or similar weapon.

achievements.description: Get 20 kills on players that you're dominating.
achievements.summary: Get 20 kills on players you are dominating.

steps.text: Keep killing the same enemy once you dominate him.

achievements.description: Survive a direct hit from a critical rocket.
achievements.summary: Live through a rocket that crits and hits you directly.

guide.context: Crit rockets fired by the Rocket Jumper or MONOCULUS work as well.

steps.text: Stay beside a friendly @mechanic{Medic} so you are overhealed.
Fight on the front line until an enemy critical rocket hits you directly.

achievements.description: Get 1000 assists.
achievements.summary: Get 1000 assists.

steps.text: Play as @mechanic{Heavy} and fire your @item{Minigun} at targets your team is fighting, even at long range.

achievements.description: Kill or assist in killing 10 cloaked Spies.
achievements.summary: Kill, or help kill, 10 cloaked Spies.

steps.text: When you see the shimmer of a cloaked @enemy{Spy}, sweep the area with your @item{Minigun}'s wide spray. Enclosed areas make this easier.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies without spinning down your gun.
achievements.summary: Get 5 kills in a row while your Minigun stays spun up.

steps.text: Defend a control point or a payload cart so enemies must come to you.
Keep your @item{Minigun} spun up the whole time. Use @item{Natascha} to stop enemies fleeing, and stay near a @item{Dispenser} or pick up dropped weapons so you do not run out of ammo.

achievements.description: Fire $200,000 worth of minigun rounds in a single life.
achievements.summary: Spend $200,000 of Minigun ammunition during one life.

steps.text: Fire your @item{Minigun} nonstop without dying. Setup time is a safe time to do it.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a critical punch.
achievements.summary: Land a fatal punch that is a critical hit.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Killing Gloves of Boxing} and kill an enemy to get a critical boost.
While the boost lasts, punch another enemy until he dies.

achievements.description: Heal 1000 damage with med-kits in a single life.
achievements.summary: Recover 1000 health from med kits during one life.

guide.context: Healing from a Medic or Dispenser does not count.

steps.text: Stay near control points, where med kits are usually close, and pick one up whenever you are hurt.
Play without a Medic healing you, then stay alive until the total reaches 1000.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with your shotgun while you're out of minigun ammo.
achievements.summary: With your Minigun empty, get a kill using the Shotgun.

guide.context: The @item{Family Business} also counts as the Shotgun.

steps.text: Fire your @item{Minigun} dry, avoiding dropped weapons and ammo packs.
Switch to your @item{Shotgun} and kill an enemy.

achievements.description: Be the first on your team to start capturing a control point in a round.
achievements.summary: In a round, start the first capture of a control point for your team.

guide.context: This also works in Sudden Death and in Arena.

steps.text: Run to the first control point as soon as the round begins. Equipping the @item{G.R.U.} or the @item{Buffalo Steak Sandvich} helps you beat faster classes there.

achievements.description: Get 50 caps on payload maps.
achievements.summary: Get credit for 50 captures on payload maps.

steps.text: Stay with the payload cart as your team pushes it; your capture credit grows as it moves.
Use your firepower to keep defenders away from the cart.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies in mid-air with the minigun.
achievements.summary: Shoot 10 airborne enemies dead with the Minigun.

steps.text: Aim at players who jump to dodge fire and follow them with your crosshair until they die in the air.

achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies while you're standing on a control point you own.
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies while you stand on a control point your team owns.

steps.text: Stand on a control point your team owns and shoot the enemies who come to it.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies capturing a control point you own.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies who are capturing a control point your team owns.

steps.text: Defend your team's control points and kill anyone who starts capturing one.

achievements.description: Help 5 teammates get revenge on their nemeses.
achievements.summary: Help 5 teammates get revenge on the enemies dominating them.

steps.text: When a teammate is dominated, kill or help kill the enemy who dominates him.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy in the first 5 seconds after you exit a teleporter.
achievements.summary: Within 5 seconds of stepping out of a teleporter, kill an enemy.

guide.context: This also counts toward the general achievement Riftwalker.

steps.text: Use a friendly @item{Teleporter} exit.
Look for a nearby enemy right away and kill him within 5 seconds. A telefrag also counts.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy with a freezecam shot of you taunting while invulnerable.
achievements.summary: Let an enemy's freezecam show you taunting while you are invulnerable.

guide.context: Taunting while ÜberCharged slows your team's push, so only try it once the area is clear.

steps.text: Get an @mechanic{ÜberCharge} from a friendly @mechanic{Medic}.
Kill the last enemy in the area, then taunt while you are still invulnerable.

achievements.description: Eat 100 sandviches.
achievements.summary: Eat 100 Sandviches.

guide.context: You can eat at full health, and a Sandvich dropped by another Heavy also counts.

steps.text: Eat your @item{Sandvich} between fights.

achievements.description: Kill 50 Scouts using Natascha.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 Scouts with Natascha.

steps.text: Equip @item{Natascha} and use its slowdown to pin Scouts so they cannot dodge your fire.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Heavies with The K.G.B.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemy Heavies with The K.G.B.

guide.context: Medieval Mode gives more chances to fight Heavies in melee.

steps.text: Equip @item{The K.G.B.}.
Sneak up on enemy Heavies, ideally when you still have the critical boost from a recent K.G.B. kill.

achievements.description: Get the first kill in an Arena or Competitive match.
achievements.summary: Score the opening kill of an Arena or Competitive match.

steps.text: Join an Arena or Competitive match.
Rush the enemy early and target players who are already hurt.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with the First Blood crit buff in an Arena match.
achievements.summary: In Arena, get 5 kills while the First Blood crit buff is on you.

guide.context: This one works only in Arena, not in Competitive.

steps.text: Get the first kill of an Arena round to receive the crit buff.
While the buff is active, kill 5 enemies. The @item{Scattergun} or @item{Pistol} lets you keep firing without reloading.

achievements.description: Kill a player in Well before the round starts.
achievements.summary: Kill a player on the map Well before the round starts.

steps.text: During setup, cross the trains in the middle of Well with the @item{Force-a-Nature} or @item{Atomizer}.
Kill an enemy before the round starts. You can also wait for a Soldier, Demoman or Scout to jump to your side.

achievements.description: Get 2004 lifetime kills.
achievements.summary: Get 2004 lifetime kills.

steps.text: Keep playing @mechanic{Scout} and flank weaker enemies.

achievements.description: In a single life, kill an enemy while you are on the ground, in the air, and in the water.
achievements.summary: Within one life, score a kill while standing on land, another while airborne, and another in water.

steps.text: Play 2Fort or Well, where water is close to the fighting.
Get the underwater kill first, then the ground and air kills in the same life.

achievements.description: Destroy 3 teleporter entrances.
achievements.summary: Destroy 3 enemy teleporter entrances.

steps.text: Run and double jump around the enemy defense to reach their @item{Teleporter} entrances. Other routes open up with the @item{Atomizer} or the @item{Force-a-Nature}.
Destroy 3 entrances.

achievements.description: Destroy 3 enemy buildings while they are still under construction.
achievements.summary: Wreck 3 enemy buildings before they finish building.

guide.context: Combat Mini-sentry guns from an Engineer with the Gunslinger finish in less than two seconds, so pick another Engineer.

steps.text: Ambush an enemy @enemy{Engineer} and destroy his buildings as soon as he places them.

achievements.description: Destroy an active sentry gun using your pistol.
achievements.summary: Destroy an active enemy sentry gun with your Pistol.

guide.context: Other players can help as long as you land the last hit. The @item{Winger} also counts as the Pistol.

steps.text: Shoot an exposed sentry gun from long range with your @item{Pistol}, especially one with no Engineer nearby.
Or circle-strafe the sentry gun so it cannot lock onto you. Combat Mini-sentry guns die fastest.

achievements.description: Achieve 10 of the achievements in the Scout pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 10 achievements in the Scout pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Scout do not count.

steps.text: Earn Scout pack achievements until you have 10.

achievements.description: Achieve 16 of the achievements in the Scout pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 16 achievements in the Scout pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Scout pack achievements until you have 16.

achievements.description: Achieve 22 of the achievements in the Scout pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 22 achievements in the Scout pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Scout pack achievements until you have 22.

achievements.description: Perform 1000 double jumps.
achievements.summary: Perform 1000 double jumps.

steps.text: Double jump as you move and fight as @mechanic{Scout}.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies while under the effects of a Medic's ÜberCharge.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies while a Medic's ÜberCharge is on you.

steps.text: Get a friendly @mechanic{Medic} to ÜberCharge you.
Use the regular @item{Scattergun} or @item{Shortstop}, because they need fewer reloads than the @item{Soda Popper} or @item{Force-a-Nature}.
Kill 3 enemies before the ÜberCharge ends.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy Heavy and take his Sandvich.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy Heavy and pick up his Sandvich.

steps.text: Follow a hurt enemy @enemy{Heavy} who retreats to eat.
Kill him while he eats and pick up the ammo pack he drops.

achievements.description: Kill a Medic that is ready to deploy an ÜberCharge.
achievements.summary: Kill a Medic whose ÜberCharge is ready to deploy.

steps.text: Look for an enemy @enemy{Medic} with a particle effect around his Medi Gun, which means his ÜberCharge is full.
Ambush him before he deploys it. @item{Crit-a-Cola} drunk just before the attack adds damage.

achievements.description: Survive 500 damage in one life.
achievements.summary: Survive 500 damage in one life.

steps.text: Leave fights early and stay near a @item{Dispenser} or a friendly @mechanic{Medic} to heal, until you have taken 500 damage without dying.

achievements.description: Kill 20 players while double-jumping.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 players while you are double-jumping.

steps.text: Double jump during fights to dodge fire and shoot while you are in the air. The @item{Force-a-Nature} is a poor choice because its recoil spoils your aim.

achievements.description: Capture the enemy intelligence 25 times.
achievements.summary: Capture the enemy intelligence 25 times.

steps.text: Play Capture the Flag and push into the enemy base while teammates distract the defenders.
Grab the intelligence and run it back to your base.

achievements.description: Capture the enemy intelligence 3 times in a single CTF round.
achievements.summary: Score 3 intelligence captures during one Capture the Flag round.

guide.context: You may die between captures. A server with a higher capture limit keeps teammates from ending the round early.

steps.text: Ask teammates to guard you while you enter the enemy base.
Take the intelligence home, then do it again until you have 3 captures in the round.

achievements.description: Dodge 1000 damage in a single life using your Bonk! Atomic Punch.
achievements.summary: Using Bonk! Atomic Punch, avoid 1000 damage without dying.

guide.context: Damage from environmental hazards, such as the train on Well, also counts.

steps.text: Drink @item{Bonk! Atomic Punch} in front of heavy fire, such as a sentry gun or Heavy.
Move to safety before the effect wears off, because you are slowed afterward.
Repeat without dying until you reach 1000.

achievements.description: Cause an environmental death or suicide using the Force-A-Nature's knockback.
achievements.summary: Push an enemy to a hazard death with the Force-a-Nature, getting the kill credit.

steps.text: Knock enemies into hazards such as bottomless pits, trains or sawblades, or off high ground so the fall kills them.

achievements.description: Kill or assist kill 50 enemies while they are stunned or slowed.
achievements.summary: Kill, or help kill, 50 enemies who are stunned or slowed.

guide.context: Enemies slowed by teammates and kills with the ball itself also count.

steps.text: Slow enemies with the @item{Sandman} while teammates are close, so they finish the target and you get the assist.
To kill alone, hit the ball from far away, then close in.

achievements.description: Cause an environmental death by stunning or slowing an enemy.
achievements.summary: Stun or slow an enemy so that a hazard kills him.

steps.text: Use the @item{Sandman} on enemies standing by hazards, like the trains on Well or the sawblades on Sawmill.
On a Payload map, you can also stun an enemy right before the last point is captured, so the blast kills him.

achievements.description: Stun 2 Medics that are ready to deploy an ÜberCharge.
achievements.summary: Stun 2 Medics whose ÜberCharge is ready to deploy.

steps.text: Sneak behind enemy lines to find a @enemy{Medic} with a particle effect around his healing weapon, which means his ÜberCharge is ready.
Stun him with a @item{Sandman} ball while he is not paying attention. Do this to 2 Medics.

achievements.description: Stun 50 enemies while they are capturing a point or pushing the cart.
achievements.summary: Stun 50 enemies who are trying to take a control point or move the payload.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Sandman} and hit enemies on a control point or payload cart with its ball.
steps.note: Any enemy on a point or cart counts, even if your team owns the point or it is locked.

achievements.description: Stun an enemy for the maximum possible duration by hitting them with a long-range ball.
achievements.summary: Stun an enemy for the longest possible time by hitting them with a ball thrown from long range.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Sandman} and play a map with large open areas.
Throw balls across the field at distant enemies.
steps.note: Aim above their heads to allow for the ball arc. Snipers are easy targets because they stand still while aiming.

achievements.description: Stun a Scout with their own ball.
achievements.summary: Stun an enemy Scout with a ball that the same Scout threw.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Sandman} and watch where an enemy @enemy{Scout} throws his ball.
Pick up that ball. It refills your Sandman ball meter.
Throw the ball back and hit that Scout.

achievements.description: Kill a Scout while they are under the effect of Crit-a-Cola.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy Scout while Crit-a-Cola is active on him.

steps.text: Find an enemy @enemy{Scout} whose weapon glows in his team color.
steps.note: That glow means he is using @item{Crit-a-Cola}, and he takes extra damage.

steps.text: Kill him. The @item{Pistol} can wear him down from range.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies from behind with the Force-A-Nature.
achievements.summary: Use the Force-a-Nature to kill 50 enemies by hitting them in the back.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Force-a-Nature} and kill enemies by shooting them in the back.
steps.note: Its burst damage kills fast when you ambush from behind.

achievements.description: Capture the last point in a CP map.
achievements.summary: Capture the last point on a control point map.

steps.text: Join a standard 5-CP control point map, which is easier than an attack and defend map.
Push in with your team, or sneak behind the enemy and wait near the last point.
Step onto the last point right after the point before it is captured, and finish the capture.

achievements.description: Capture three capture points in a row in one life.
achievements.summary: Capture three control points in a row without dying.

steps.text: Play a standard control point map such as @loc{Well} or @loc{Granary}, where points often change hands.
Capture three points in one life.
steps.note: Retreat if a group of enemies arrives while you capture.

achievements.description: Start capping a capture point within a second of it becoming available.
achievements.summary: Start capturing a control point within one second of it becoming available.

steps.text: Sneak behind enemy lines and wait next to the next control point.
Step onto the point right after the point before it is captured.
steps.note: You only need to start the capture, not finish it.

achievements.description: Initiate 10 point captures that ultimately succeed.
achievements.summary: Start 10 point captures that end with your team owning the point.

steps.text: Be the first to step onto a control point and start its capture.
steps.note: The capture must finish. Your team can finish it, or you can capture it alone.

steps.text: Repeat until 10 captures that you started have succeeded.

achievements.description: Block 50 point captures.
achievements.summary: Block 50 control point captures.

steps.text: Stand on a control point and kill attackers who try to capture it.
steps.note: Stay on the point until you have killed the attackers.

achievements.description: Kill an opposing player that has your intelligence while holding theirs.
achievements.summary: In Capture the Flag, kill an enemy who carries your intelligence while you carry theirs.

steps.text: At the start of a CTF round, rush to the enemy intelligence before their defenses are set.
Pick it up, then find the enemy carrier.
steps.note: Your intelligence compass is off while you carry theirs, so ask your team where he is.

steps.text: Or camp near an intelligence room and, while you hold the enemy intelligence, kill whoever picks up yours.

achievements.description: Steal and then capture the enemy intelligence without firing a shot.
achievements.summary: Pick up the enemy intelligence and capture it at your base without firing a gun.

steps.text: Pick up the enemy intelligence, including one a teammate dropped.
Carry it to your base and capture it without shooting.
steps.note: Your melee weapon is still allowed.

achievements.description: Run 25 kilometers.
achievements.summary: Run a total of 25 kilometers as Scout.

steps.text: Play as @enemy{Scout} and keep running. The distance adds up as you play.

achievements.description: Bat an enemy 25 meters.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the Sandman taunt so the body flies 25 meters.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Sandman} and choose an open outdoor area.
steps.note: The body must fly 25 meters without hitting another object.

steps.text: Taunt beside an enemy who is busy, like a Sniper looking down a scope or a Heavy with his minigun spun up.
steps.note: The taunt is silent but long. Drinking @item{Bonk! Atomic Punch} first protects you from other enemies while you taunt.

achievements.description: Jarate an enemy that you're dominating.
achievements.summary: Hit an enemy you are dominating with Jarate.

steps.text: Note which enemy you are dominating.
steps.note: Stay near teammates if you must approach the front line, so that enemy cannot single you out.

steps.text: Throw @item{Jarate} at that enemy.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy with a freezecam shot of you doffing your hat.
achievements.summary: Give an enemy a freezecam shot of you tipping your hat.

steps.text: Kill an enemy, then taunt right away with your melee weapon equipped.

achievements.description: Get 3 kills with the Sniper Rifle without missing a shot.
achievements.summary: Land 3 Sniper Rifle kills with no missed shots.

steps.text: Shoot only when you are sure to hit. Slow targets such as @enemy{Heavy} and @enemy{Soldier} are safest; skip Scouts.
steps.note: The 3 kills do not have to be in one life.

achievements.description: Capture the flag in CTF.
achievements.summary: Capture the enemy intelligence in Capture the Flag as Sniper.

steps.text: Pick up the enemy intelligence when you get a chance and run it to your base.
Defend yourself with the @item{Submachine Gun} or uncharged rifle shots.

achievements.description: Kill 1000 enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill 1000 enemies as Sniper.

steps.text: Play as @enemy{Sniper} and keep killing. The count adds up as you play.

achievements.description: In a single round, get a kill with 3 different weapons.
achievements.summary: Within one round, kill with 3 different weapons.

steps.text: Get a kill with each of 3 different weapons in the same round.
steps.note: The kills can be on different enemies and in different lives. You can change weapons at any time, and 3 melee weapons are fine.

achievements.description: Headshot 10 enemy Snipers.
achievements.summary: Headshot 10 enemy Snipers.

steps.text: Aim at the head of enemy Snipers without charging your shot.
steps.note: One headshot kills any Sniper who has no extra health. Do not use the @item{Sydney Sleeper}, because its headshots do much less damage.

achievements.description: Destroy 3 Engineer sentry guns.
achievements.summary: Destroy 3 Engineer sentry guns.

steps.text: Shoot a sentry gun with fully charged shots.
steps.note: One fully charged shot destroys a Level 1 sentry gun. Two destroy any sentry without a shield.

steps.text: Kill the Engineer first if he is fixing the sentry or has a @item{Wrangler} shield up.

achievements.description: Kill a fully invisible Spy in a single hit.
achievements.summary: Kill a fully invisible Spy with a single hit.

steps.text: Watch areas where a Spy is likely to be, and look for the cloak shimmer. Shoot where he will go.
Use an attack that kills in one hit: a charged shot, a headshot, or a critical melee hit.

achievements.description: Kill a Scout in midair with your Sniper Rifle or the Huntsman.
achievements.summary: Kill a Scout who is in midair with the Sniper Rifle or the Huntsman.

steps.text: Watch Scouts for a jump, in a fight or while traveling, and shoot at the moment they are in the air.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy with a freezecam shot of you waving to them.
achievements.summary: Give an enemy a freezecam shot of you waving at them.

steps.text: Kill an enemy, then taunt right away with a primary weapon equipped, but not the @item{Huntsman}.

achievements.description: Dominate an enemy Sniper.
achievements.summary: Dominate an enemy Sniper.

steps.text: Keep winning fights against the same enemy @enemy{Sniper}. Shoot from unexpected places and aim for headshots.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Spies with your Kukri.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Spies with your Kukri.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Kukri}. When you hear a Spy decloak, turn around and check nearby teammates for a Spy.
Kill the Spy with the Kukri.

achievements.description: Headshot an enemy Demoman.
achievements.summary: Headshot an enemy Demoman.

steps.text: Aim at the head of an enemy @enemy{Demoman}.
steps.note: A Demoman is easy to hit when he stops to place stickies or fights up close.

achievements.description: Kill a rocket or grenade-jumping enemy in midair with your Sniper Rifle or the Huntsman.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy who is rocket jumping or grenade jumping while he is in midair, using the Sniper Rifle or the Huntsman.

steps.text: Watch spots that need a rocket or sticky jump to reach.
Shoot a jumper in midair.
steps.note: Jumpers are often already hurt, so a fully charged body shot may be enough.

achievements.description: In a single life, kill 3 enemies while they are achieving an objective.
achievements.summary: Within one life, kill 3 enemies who are busy with an objective, like holding a control point or pushing the payload.

steps.text: Wait until your target is standing on the control point or pushing the payload cart, then kill them.

achievements.description: Get 5 kills with the Sniper Rifle without your scope.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies with the Sniper Rifle while never zooming in.

steps.text: Shoot the rifle without scoping in.
steps.note: An unscoped shot deals only 50 damage. Hurt the target first with @item{Submachine Gun} bullets, @item{Jarate}, or a rifle headshot.

achievements.description: Kill a Medic that is ready to deploy an ÜberCharge.
achievements.summary: Kill a Medic whose ÜberCharge is ready to use.

steps.text: Look for a Medic with a particle effect around his Medi Gun, which shows a full ÜberCharge.
Shoot him from an unexpected angle.
steps.note: Medics avoid wide open areas to stay out of your sights.

achievements.description: Get backstabbed 50 times.
achievements.summary: Get backstabbed 50 times.

steps.text: Let enemy Spies backstab you. Leave your back open on purpose to speed this up.
steps.note: Do not use the @item{Razorback}.

achievements.description: Kill an opponent within the first second of a round.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy within the first second of a round.

steps.text: Choose a map that has a setup phase. Charge your shot early, then fire at an enemy the instant the gates open.
steps.note: In King of the Hill you can do this at any time before the control point is first captured.

achievements.description: Headshot an enemy player the moment his invulnerability wears off.
achievements.summary: Headshot an enemy at the moment his invulnerability ends.

steps.text: Keep your crosshair on the head of an invulnerable enemy.
steps.note: Targets include a patient under a Medic's ÜberCharge, or a Pyro who is mid-taunt with a full @item{Phlogistinator}.

steps.text: Fire as soon as the invulnerability wears off.

achievements.description: Top the scoreboard 10 times on teams of 6 or more players.
achievements.summary: Be the top scorer 10 times when your team has 6 or more players.

steps.text: Earn points with headshots, since a Sniper earns 1.5 points per headshot.
To get a lead, start the round as a class like @enemy{Medic}, then change to Sniper and play out the round.
steps.note: Medics tend to earn many points each life.

achievements.description: Kill a spy whose backstab attempt was blocked by your Razorback.
achievements.summary: Kill a Spy whose backstab was blocked by your Razorback.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Razorback} and let a Spy try to backstab you.
steps.note: The Razorback blocks the backstab and breaks.

steps.text: Attack the Spy with your @item{Kukri} and kill him.
steps.note: Spies who see the Razorback usually switch to their Revolver, so inexperienced Spies work best.

achievements.description: Jarate 4 enemy players with a single throw.
achievements.summary: Hit 4 enemy players with a single Jarate throw.

steps.text: Throw @item{Jarate} at a crowd near a control point, around the payload cart, or by the gates when a round begins.

achievements.description: Jarate an enemy and the Medic healing him.
achievements.summary: Soak an enemy and his healer Medic with one Jarate.

steps.text: Aim @item{Jarate} between an enemy @enemy{Medic} and his patient.

achievements.description: Use Jarate to reveal a cloaked Spy.
achievements.summary: Reveal a cloaked Spy by hitting him with Jarate.

steps.text: Throw @item{Jarate} into corners and recesses where a Spy could hide.
Or throw @item{Jarate} at the path of a cloaked Spy that bumps into you.
steps.note: Scout's @item{Mad Milk} or a Pyro reflecting Jarate also counts.

achievements.description: Extinguish a burning teammate with your Jarate.
achievements.summary: Put out a burning teammate by hitting him with Jarate.

steps.text: Hit a teammate who is burning with @item{Jarate}.

achievements.description: Pin an enemy Heavy to the wall via his head.
achievements.summary: Pin an enemy Heavy to a wall with an arrow through his head.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Huntsman}. Aim at a @enemy{Heavy}'s head when he is near a wall.
steps.note: A fully charged headshot kills any Heavy who has no extra health.

achievements.description: Kill a Heavy & Medic pair with the bow.
achievements.summary: Kill a Heavy and Medic pair with the Huntsman.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Huntsman} and stay a medium distance away from the pair.
Kill the @enemy{Medic} first, then the @enemy{Heavy}.
steps.note: The Medic is usually at the rear and harder to hit than the Heavy.

achievements.description: Take down an intelligence carrier with a single arrow.
achievements.summary: Kill someone carrying the intelligence using just one arrow.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Huntsman} in Capture the Flag and pick a spot that sees the routes out of your intelligence room.
Shoot a carrier as he runs home, such as a Scout.
steps.note: The Huntsman stab taunt on a carrier also works.

achievements.description: Hit an enemy with 3 arrows, without killing them.
achievements.summary: Land 3 arrows on one enemy, and he must stay alive.

steps.text: Shoot a tough target such as a @enemy{Soldier} or @enemy{Heavy} with uncharged arrows to the body.
steps.note: Do not aim at the head or charge shots, so you do not kill him by accident.

achievements.description: Score 5 assists with the Jarate in a single round.
achievements.summary: Get 5 assists with Jarate in one life.

steps.text: Throw @item{Jarate} at crowded places: narrow passages, control points, and the gates when a round starts.
steps.note: The 5 assists must come in a single life.

steps.text: Use the @item{Sydney Sleeper} to soak enemies from farther away.

achievements.description: Jarate and then kill 3 enemies with your Kukri.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies with a melee weapon after hitting them all with a single Jarate throw.

steps.text: Equip one of these melee weapons: @item{Bushwacka}, @item{Shahanshah}, @item{Saxxy}, @item{Kukri}, @item{Conscientious Objector} or @item{Tribalman's Shiv}. Hit a group with one @item{Jarate} throw, then kill 3 of those soaked enemies with melee.
Play a five-point control point map or Payload, where players gather.
steps.note: A Medic who heals you the whole time helps.

achievements.description: Stab an enemy with an arrow.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the Huntsman stab taunt.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Huntsman} and walk up to an unaware enemy, such as a Sniper who is busy.
Use the taunt to stab him with an arrow.
steps.note: The taunt takes one second, is silent and stuns the target.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with an arrow while you're dead.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with an arrow after you have died.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Huntsman}. Fight an enemy who is close enough to hit back.
Shoot just before you die. You can also hold an arrow drawn, which fires by itself at death.
steps.note: Arrows take time to fly. Kills from the burning of a lit arrow also count. A key bound to the kill console command lets you die right after you fire.

achievements.description: Backstab 3 Snipers in a single life.
achievements.summary: Backstab 3 Snipers in one life.

steps.text: Play a map that favors Snipers, such as @loc{2Fort}, where many Snipers stand in a line.
steps.note: You can retreat after the first or second backstab; the three do not need to be close in time.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy with a freezecam shot of you flicking a cigarette onto their corpse.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy so that their freezecam shows you flicking a cigarette onto their body.

steps.text: Kill an enemy, stand on the corpse, and taunt with the Disguise Kit equipped.
steps.note: The Spy Crab taunt also counts.

achievements.description: Backstab a disguised Spy.
achievements.summary: Backstab an enemy Spy who is disguised.

steps.text: Find an enemy Spy. One who decloaks near your team is already disguised, and a sapper on a friendly building means a disguised Spy is close.
Spy-check by walking behind teammates with the Knife equipped.
steps.note: If the Knife raises on its own, that teammate is an enemy Spy.

steps.text: Backstab that Spy.

achievements.description: Backstab the enemy that you're currently disguised as.
achievements.summary: Backstab the enemy player you are currently disguised as.

steps.text: Disguise as an enemy. Your screen shows the name of the player you copy.
Find that player and @mechanic{backstab} them.

achievements.description: Stab an enemy while fencing.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the Spy's fencing kill taunt.

guide.context: You must be undisguised and uncloaked, and this cannot be earned during Humiliation.

steps.text: Hide out of sight, for example behind a corner or beside the exit of an enemy @mechanic{Teleporter}.
Start the fencing taunt when a hurt enemy is in reach of the last strike. The first two strikes do little damage and warn the enemy.

achievements.description: Backstab a Medic who has healed you in the last 5 seconds.
achievements.summary: Backstab a Medic whose healing reached you during the previous 5 seconds.

steps.text: Disguise as a class that fits the fight, such as Soldier or Pyro, and let an enemy @enemy{Medic} heal you.
Stay in the fight. Do not run backward after the heal, or the Medic will see you are a Spy.
@mechanic{Backstab} that Medic within 5 seconds of the last heal.

achievements.displayName: The Man with the Broken Guns
achievements.description: Backstab an Engineer, then sap 3 of his buildings within 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Within 10 seconds of backstabbing an Engineer, sap 3 of that Engineer's buildings.

guide.context: A sapper on each building is enough. None has to be destroyed.

steps.text: Find an @enemy{Engineer} whose building stands next to an active Teleporter.
@mechanic{Backstab} the Engineer.
Sap that building and the Teleporter within 10 seconds. A second sapper appears on the other end of the Teleporter, which makes 3.

achievements.description: Sap an enemy building, then backstab the Engineer who built it within 5 seconds.
achievements.summary: Backstab an Engineer within 5 seconds of sapping a building that Engineer built.

steps.text: Use your cloak or disguise to sneak up behind a busy @enemy{Engineer}.
Sap one of that Engineer's buildings, switch to your knife at once, and @mechanic{backstab} the Engineer within 5 seconds.
If the Engineer has left, hide near the building until he returns to repair it.

achievements.description: Backstab an enemy and the Medic healing him within 10 seconds of each other.
achievements.summary: Backstab both an enemy and the Medic who is healing them, no more than 10 seconds apart.

steps.text: Find an enemy Medic and the enemy he is healing as they head to the front line.
@mechanic{Backstab} the faster one first, which is usually the Medic, then the other within 10 seconds.

achievements.description: Backstab your Steam Community friends 10 times.
achievements.summary: Land 10 backstabs on players from your Steam friends list.

guide.context: All 10 backstabs can be on the same friend.

steps.text: Join a server where your friends are on the other team.
@mechanic{Backstab} your friends until you reach 10 backstabs in total.

achievements.description: Dominate a Sniper.
achievements.summary: Dominate an enemy Sniper.

steps.text: Pick an enemy @enemy{Sniper} who is not watching and keep killing that same player until you dominate them.
Do not let that Sniper get an assist on your own death.
If the Sniper wears a @item{Razorback}, fire three @item{Revolver} shots from point-blank range, or two @item{Ambassador} shots if you land the opening one as a headshot from close range.

achievements.description: While cloaked, bump into an enemy cloaked Spy.
achievements.summary: Run into an enemy Spy who is cloaked too, while you are cloaked yourself.

steps.text: Cloak and walk the quiet routes that few players use. An enemy cloaked Spy on the same path will eventually bump into you.

achievements.description: Kill a gun-wielding Spy with your knife.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy Spy who is holding a gun with your knife.

steps.text: Chase an enemy @enemy{Spy} who is near his own lines, retreating or just respawned. He likely holds a @item{Revolver}. Kill him with your knife.

achievements.description: Survive 30 seconds after being ignited while cloaked.
achievements.summary: Survive 30 seconds after being set on fire while cloaked.

steps.text: Let a @enemy{Pyro} set you on fire while you are cloaked. Flames still reveal you.
Run to safety and put out the flames with a health kit.
Stay out of combat until 30 seconds have passed since you ignited.

achievements.description: Kill a Sniper after your backstab breaks his Razorback.
achievements.summary: Kill a Sniper once your backstab has broken his Razorback.

steps.text: @mechanic{Backstab} a @enemy{Sniper} who wears a @item{Razorback}. The first backstab breaks it and shocks you.
Kill him before he reacts, with a second backstab, a @item{Revolver} shot or an @item{Ambassador} headshot.

achievements.description: Kill an Engineer who is working on a sentry gun.
achievements.summary: Kill an Engineer while he is busy with a sentry gun.

steps.text: Look for an @enemy{Engineer} setting up or fixing a sentry gun close to a hotly fought choke point.
While your team pushes through, @mechanic{backstab} the Engineer as he works on it.

achievements.description: Start capping a capture point within a second of it becoming available.
