achievements.summary: Start capturing a control point within one second of it becoming available.

guide.context: You only need to start the capture, not finish it.

steps.text: Sneak behind enemy lines and wait on the next locked control point. The @item{Cloak and Dagger} lets you hide as long as you like.
Step onto the point the moment your team's capture of the previous point unlocks it.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy while you're being healed by an enemy Medic.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy while an enemy Medic is healing you.

steps.text: Disguise and wait in a large firefight until an enemy @enemy{Medic} starts healing you.
@mechanic{Backstab} the nearest enemy before the Medic notices.
With @item{Your Eternal Reward}, backstabbing a Medic's patient makes you healed automatically.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies who are standing on a control point they own.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies while they stand on a control point owned by their team.

steps.text: Approach an active control point from an unexpected angle. Players there check for Spies.
Kill the enemies standing on it until you reach 15. Backstabbing enemies who pass through a locked control point also counts.

achievements.description: Backstab an enemy who is dominating 3 or more of your teammates.
achievements.summary: Backstab an enemy that currently dominates at least 3 players on your team.

steps.text: Check the scoreboard for an enemy who dominates 3 or more of your teammates.
Wait until that enemy is distracted, then @mechanic{backstab} them. They are likely more alert than most players.

achievements.description: Get a Revenge kill with a backstab.
achievements.summary: Earn a Revenge kill by backstabbing.

steps.text: Find the enemy who is dominating you, then @mechanic{backstab} that enemy.
If nobody dominates you, you can let a class you handle well, such as a Sniper, dominate you on purpose.

achievements.description: Stab an enemy to death while under the influence of Jarate.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with your knife while Jarate is on you.

steps.text: Get hit by @item{Jarate} or the @item{Sydney Sleeper} from a @enemy{Sniper}.
Stay out of that Sniper's line of fire and stab to death a different enemy who has not noticed you.

achievements.description: Backstab 3 enemies within 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Backstab 3 enemies within 10 seconds.

steps.text: Slip behind enemy lines where three enemies have their backs to you, then @mechanic{backstab} all three within 10 seconds.

achievements.description: Backstab 1000 enemies.
achievements.summary: Backstab 1000 enemies.

steps.text: Play as Spy and @mechanic{backstab} enemies until the total reaches 1000.

achievements.description: Destroy 1000 Engineer buildings with sappers.
achievements.summary: Destroy 1000 Engineer buildings with sappers.

guide.context: Only the default Sapper counts, not the Red-Tape Recorder. You also get credit when a teammate destroys a building while your sapper is on it.

steps.text: Sap enemy Engineer buildings with the default Sapper until 1000 are destroyed.

achievements.description: Sap an enemy sentry gun within 3 seconds of a teammate sapping another.
achievements.summary: Sap an enemy sentry gun no more than 3 seconds after a teammate saps a different one.

steps.text: Team up with another Spy against an enemy team with several sentry guns.
Sap a different sentry within 3 seconds of your partner.

achievements.description: Backstab a Medic that is ready to deploy an ÜberCharge.
achievements.summary: Backstab a Medic whose ÜberCharge is ready to use.

guide.context: Any ÜberCharge from a Vaccinator counts, which makes this easier.

steps.text: Watch for an enemy @enemy{Medic} whose ÜberCharge is ready.
Sneak up and @mechanic{backstab} that Medic before the ÜberCharge is used. The @item{Cloak and Dagger} helps you follow a Medic who is still building the charge.

achievements.description: Backstab 50 enemies who are capturing control points.
achievements.summary: Backstab 50 enemies while they are in the middle of capturing control points.

steps.text: Hunt around control points with few defenders, such as the ones on Gravel Pit, or around players crowding the Payload cart.
@mechanic{Backstab} enemies who are capturing until you reach 50.

achievements.description: Backstab an enemy, who then switches to Pyro before they respawn.
achievements.summary: Backstab an enemy who changes to the Pyro class before respawning.

guide.context: The victim chooses to switch, so you cannot force it.

steps.text: Keep backstabbing enemies until one switches to Pyro before respawning.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with the Ambassador.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with the Ambassador.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Ambassador} and land headshots on unaware enemies.
Use your cloak to finish hurt players as they retreat.

achievements.description: While using the Ambassador, kill 20 Snipers with a headshot.
achievements.summary: Headshot and kill 20 Snipers with the Ambassador equipped.

guide.context: An Ambassador headshot deals 102 damage up close and less from far away, so pick injured Snipers or ones away from the front line.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Ambassador} instead of the knife when you could backstab a @enemy{Sniper}.
Headshot Snipers until you have 20 kills.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy who triggered your feign death in the last 20 seconds.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy that caused your feign death, within 20 seconds afterward.

steps.text: Use the @item{Dead Ringer}. Let an enemy hurt you a little first so the fake death looks real.
Kill that enemy within 20 seconds of your feign death.

achievements.description: Headshot 3 Scouts with the Ambassador.
achievements.summary: Headshot 3 Scouts with the Ambassador.

guide.context: A Spy cannot zoom, so close range is easier. Scouts in a fight are often hurt, and one headshot deals 102 damage.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Ambassador} and aim where each @enemy{Scout} will be, not where he is.
Land headshots on 3 Scouts.

achievements.description: While using the Cloak and Dagger, kill the same enemy 3 times, all within the same area in a single life.
achievements.summary: With the Cloak and Dagger equipped, kill one enemy 3 times in a single life, all in the same area.

guide.context: The three kills can be spread over a long time, but you must not die. A Razorback or Jarate can make a Sniper a poor target.

steps.text: Camp an area with a lot of player traffic and equip the @item{Cloak and Dagger}. Use your ability to see the names above players to pick one target.
Kill that same player 3 times in that area without dying. Play carefully, because a victim who was backstabbed twice may hunt you.

achievements.description: Achieve 5 of the achievements in the Sniper pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 5 achievements in the Sniper pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Sniper do not count.

steps.text: Earn Sniper pack achievements until you have 5.

achievements.description: Achieve 11 of the achievements in the Sniper pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 11 achievements in the Sniper pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Sniper pack achievements until you have 11.

achievements.description: Achieve 17 of the achievements in the Sniper pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 17 achievements in the Sniper pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Sniper pack achievements until you have 17.

achievements.description: Achieve 5 of the achievements in the Spy pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 5 achievements in the Spy pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Spy do not count.

steps.text: Earn Spy pack achievements until you have 5.

achievements.description: Achieve 11 of the achievements in the Spy pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 11 achievements in the Spy pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Spy pack achievements until you have 11.

achievements.description: Achieve 17 of the achievements in the Spy pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 17 achievements in the Spy pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Spy pack achievements until you have 17.

achievements.description: Collect 20 Halloween pumpkins from dead players to unlock a hat.
achievements.summary: Collect 20 Halloween pumpkins dropped by dead players.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running. The reward is the Mildly Disturbing Halloween Mask.

steps.text: Pick up pumpkins that drop from dead players. Each death has a 30% chance to drop one, no matter who got the kill.
Use the short critical buff from each pumpkin to kill more enemies.

achievements.description: Dominate a player wearing any achievement Gibus hat to earn your own Ghostly Gibus.
achievements.summary: Dominate anyone who is wearing an achievement Gibus hat.

guide.context: This works at any time of year. The reward is the Ghostly Gibus.

steps.text: Find a player wearing a Gibus hat.
Keep killing that player until you dominate them.

achievements.description: Kill a player scared by a ghost.
achievements.summary: Kill a player who is scared by a ghost.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: On a Halloween map with ghosts, such as Harvest Event or Eyeaduct, wait for players who walk into a ghost.
Kill a player while he is scared. Players fighting the Horseless Headless Horsemann on the Mann Manor map can get scared by him as well.

achievements.description: Cause the deaths of 5 players by exploding nearby pumpkin bombs.
achievements.summary: Get 5 players killed by shooting pumpkin bombs next to them.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: Stay near busy areas on a Halloween map and shoot pumpkin bombs when an enemy is close to them.
Do this until 5 players die from the blasts. Bombs respawn quickly.

achievements.description: Kill a Spy disguised as your current class.
achievements.summary: Kill a Spy who is disguised as your current class.

guide.context: This works at any time of year.

steps.text: Spy-check players of your own class and kill the enemy @enemy{Spy} hidden among them.

achievements.description: Achieve 5 of the achievements in the Soldier pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 5 achievements in the Soldier pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Soldier do not count.

steps.text: Earn Soldier pack achievements until you have 5.

achievements.description: Achieve 11 of the achievements in the Soldier pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 11 achievements in the Soldier pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Soldier pack achievements until you have 11.

achievements.description: Achieve 17 of the achievements in the Soldier pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 17 achievements in the Soldier pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Soldier pack achievements until you have 17.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with a single critical rocket.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies using one rocket that is a critical hit.

steps.text: Equip the stock @item{Rocket Launcher} for its larger splash radius and fire at a tight group of enemies.
If you cannot get critical rockets, ask a Medic to give you the @item{Kritzkrieg}.

achievements.description: Rocket jump and kill 2 enemies before you land.
achievements.summary: Kill 2 enemies during one rocket jump, before your feet touch the ground.

steps.text: Carry the @item{B.A.S.E. Jumper} plus a stock @item{Rocket Launcher} so you hang in the air longer.
Rocket jump into a group of enemies and kill 2 of them before you land.
Killing two enemies at once with the grenade taunt (Equalizer or Escape Plan) also counts.

achievements.description: Get 3 dominations in a single life.
achievements.summary: Reach 3 dominations without dying.

steps.text: Once you have your first domination, play safely. Stay near your own Medic or use a banner to earn assists.
Keep going without dying until you have 3 dominations.

achievements.description: In a single life, kill 3 enemies who have damaged a Medic that is healing you.
achievements.summary: Without dying, kill 3 enemies who hurt a Medic while that Medic is healing you.

guide.context: It can be more than one Medic. If your Medic dies, another Medic can continue the count.

steps.text: Stay with your own Medic who is healing you.
Kill each enemy who hurts that Medic until you have 3 kills in one life.

achievements.description: Use a grenade to gib a player.
achievements.summary: Gib a player with the Soldier's grenade taunt.

guide.context: The taunt also kills you. It does not work during Humiliation.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Equalizer} or @item{Escape Plan}.
Taunt from a place nobody watches, like behind a corner or next to an enemy Teleporter exit, or near a busy @enemy{Sniper} or @enemy{Heavy}.
If you hurt an enemy Soldier who finishes his taunt, you still get the credit.

achievements.description: Kill 5 Engineer sentries while you are standing outside of their range.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemy sentry guns while standing outside their range.

steps.text: Fire rockets at an enemy sentry gun from far away. Buildings take no falloff damage.
Kill the Engineer first if he is repairing that sentry gun or controlling it with the Wrangler.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy sniper with a rocket after he kills you.
achievements.summary: After an enemy Sniper has killed you, kill that Sniper with a rocket.

guide.context: The Sniper must be the one credited with your death.

steps.text: Fight a @enemy{Sniper} up close. After he hurts you, fire a rocket that kills both of you. He gets credit for your death.
Or fire rockets at Snipers from a distance to draw their attention and hope one kills you.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy soldier while both you and the target are airborne.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy Soldier while you and that Soldier are both in the air.

steps.text: Jump or rocket jump near an enemy @enemy{Soldier} who is in the air, then kill him with rockets or the @item{Shotgun} before either of you lands.

achievements.description: Kill an Engineer as he repairs his sentry gun while it's under enemy fire.
achievements.summary: Kill an Engineer while he is repairing his sentry gun and that sentry gun is under attack.

steps.text: Push toward an enemy @item{sentry gun} with your team and circle around it.
Kill the @enemy{Engineer} with a rocket splash while he repairs the sentry gun.

achievements.description: Kill your nemesis with a shovel.
achievements.summary: Kill your nemesis with a melee weapon.

guide.context: Any melee weapon counts, not only the Shovel.

steps.text: Chase your nemesis down and kill him with a melee weapon.
To close the distance, use the @item{Escape Plan}, or rocket jump into range and swing the @item{Market Gardener} while you are in the air.

achievements.description: Destroy 10 stickybombs with the shotgun in a single life.
achievements.summary: In one life, destroy 10 Stickybombs by shooting them with the Shotgun.

guide.context: Demomen often detonate their Stickybombs once they see someone shooting them, so expect to need several lives.

steps.text: Switch to the @item{Shotgun} and shoot enemy Stickybombs from a safe distance.
Destroy 10 in the same life.

achievements.description: Get the highest possible rocket jump using jump and crouch.
achievements.summary: Perform a rocket jump while jumping and crouching.

guide.context: The jump does not need to reach the maximum height.

steps.text: Aim a rocket at the ground by your feet, then jump and crouch as you fire it.

achievements.description: Buff 5 Steam friends at once with the Buff Banner.
achievements.summary: Use the Buff Banner to buff 5 Steam friends at the same time.

guide.context: The Battalion's Backup and the Concheror also count.

steps.text: Play with a group of Steam friends and stay together in fights.
After your team wins a round, use the banner in the enemy spawn, where everyone usually gathers, to buff all 5 friends at once.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies from above.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies while you are attacking from higher ground.

guide.context: You do not need to be in the air or rocket jumping.

steps.text: Shoot down at enemies from high places, like the middle of @loc{Well}, point C of @loc{Gravel Pit}, or the spires of @loc{Badlands}.
Repeat until you have 20 kills.

achievements.description: Shoot two non-boosted crit rockets in a row.
achievements.summary: Fire two random critical rockets in a row, without using a crit boost.

guide.context: Crit boosts such as the Kritzkrieg do not count, so this comes down to luck. Your random crit chance rises with the damage you have recently dealt, up to 12% per shot.

steps.text: Stay on the attack and keep dealing damage to raise your crit chance.
Keep firing rockets until two random crits come one after the other.

achievements.description: Kill 3 defenseless players after a single match has ended.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 defenseless players during the Humiliation phase after your team wins.

steps.text: Head to the enemy spawn room shortly before your team wins the round.
When the Humiliation phase starts, kill at least 3 enemies by any means.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies while you are on fire.
achievements.summary: Get 20 kills while you are burning.

steps.text: When a @enemy{Pyro} sets you on fire, keep fighting and kill nearby enemies.
Repeat until you have 20 kills while burning.

achievements.description: Kill 5 stunned or slowed players.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 players who are stunned or slowed.

steps.text: Team up with a @enemy{Scout} using the @item{Sandman} or a @enemy{Heavy} using the @item{Natascha}, who slow enemies.
Kill the slowed enemies until you have 5 kills.

achievements.description: Provide the enemy with a freezecam of you taunting over 3 of their body parts.
achievements.summary: Taunt over 3 of an enemy's body parts so that enemy's freezecam shows it.

steps.text: Gib an enemy in a small enclosed space, then taunt right away.
Repeat until an enemy's freezecam shows you taunting over at least 3 of their body parts.

achievements.description: Kill a Spy who just backstabbed a teammate.
achievements.summary: Kill a Spy who has just backstabbed a teammate.

steps.text: Watch the kill feed and listen for a teammate's scream to find the @enemy{Spy}.
Kill him by any means. If he cloaks, use rocket splash damage to find him.

achievements.description: Defend a cap point 30 times.
achievements.summary: Defend a control point 30 times.

guide.context: Guarding the Payload cart also counts, as does killing an enemy who carries your team's intelligence.

steps.text: Stay near contested points and kill enemies who are capturing or pushing there.
Repeat until you reach 30 defenses.

achievements.description: Gib 1000 people.
achievements.summary: Gib 1000 enemies.

guide.context: The enemy must burst into gibs, and a ragdoll death does not count. The Cow Mangler 5000 counts when it disintegrates an enemy.

steps.text: Play Soldier and kill enemies with explosive weapons until 1000 of them gib.

achievements.description: While rocket jumping kill an enemy with the Equalizer before you land or just after landing.
achievements.summary: Rocket jump and kill an enemy with the Equalizer, either in the air or right after you land.

steps.text: Rocket jump toward a weakened enemy.
Hit him with the @item{Equalizer} while still in the air or just as you touch down.

achievements.description: Buff 15 teammates with the Buff Banner in a single life.
achievements.summary: Use the Buff Banner on 15 teammates in one life.

guide.context: The Battalion's Backup and the Concheror also count. On a server with 32 players, plan to use the banner at least twice in the same life.

steps.text: Fight on the front lines so the banner meter fills quickly.
When the banner is ready, gather your teammates and activate it near them.
Keep going in the same life until 15 teammates have been buffed in total.

achievements.description: Kill 500 enemy Demomen
achievements.summary: Kill 500 enemy Demomen.

steps.text: Attack enemy @enemy{Demomen} directly, because their indirect weapons hit you less easily.
Use the @item{Shotgun} and @item{Equalizer}, which do more damage than their melee weapons, until you reach 500 kills.

achievements.description: Kill a Pyro who has airblasted one of your rockets in the last 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Kill a Pyro within 10 seconds of that Pyro airblasting one of your rockets.

steps.text: Shoot at a @enemy{Pyro} until he airblasts one of your rockets.
Kill him within 10 seconds. Fire at nearby walls for splash damage, or swap to the @item{Shotgun}.

achievements.description: Kill 3 players with the Equalizer in a single life without being healed.
achievements.summary: In one life and with no healing, kill 3 players using the Equalizer.

guide.context: Do not take healing from Medics, Dispensers or health pickups before you finish.

steps.text: Rocket jump to reach enemies quickly, taking care not to take too much damage.
Get 3 kills with the @item{Equalizer} in one life, taking no healing.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies with your Equalizer while you have less than 25 health.
achievements.summary: Get 20 Equalizer kills while your health is below 25.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Equalizer}. It deals more damage the lower your health is.
With under 25 health, kill nearby enemies until you reach 20 kills.

achievements.description: Bounce an opponent into the air with a rocket and then kill them with the shotgun before they land.
achievements.summary: Send an enemy flying with a rocket, then shoot him dead with the Shotgun before he lands.

steps.text: Aim a rocket at an enemy's feet to knock him up. One or two rockets also wear him down.
Switch to the @item{Shotgun} or @item{Reserve Shooter} and kill him before he lands.

achievements.description: Kill 10 opponents who are airborne with the Direct Hit.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 airborne opponents with the Direct Hit.

guide.context: Enemies only need to be in the air when they die; you do not need to keep them up.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Direct Hit}.
Kill enemies who are in the air. You can launch them yourself or use ones your teammates launch.

achievements.description: Provide the enemy with a freezecam of your 21 gun salute.
achievements.summary: Make an enemy's freezecam show your 21 gun salute taunt.

steps.text: Right after a kill, taunt while holding the @item{Shotgun}, the @item{Reserve Shooter} or the @item{Panic Attack}.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies while assisting or being assisted by another Soldier.
achievements.summary: Get 10 kills in which another Soldier assists you or you assist him.

steps.text: Play with another @enemy{Soldier} on your team and attack the same targets.
If you both use the @item{Buff Banner}, the mini-crits from each other add damage.

achievements.description: Finish a round as an MVP on a team of 6 or more players 10 times.
achievements.summary: Be an MVP at the end of 10 rounds, each on a team with at least 6 players.

guide.context: MVPs are the three top-scoring players on the winning team.

steps.text: Join large fights and capture objectives to score high.
If your score lags, play another class such as @enemy{Medic} to build a lead, then switch to Soldier before the round ends.
Do this until you have finished 10 rounds as MVP.

achievements.description: Ride the cart for 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: Ride the Payload cart for 30 seconds.

guide.context: Payload Race maps do not work for this.

steps.text: Stay next to the Payload cart for 30 seconds.
Longer Payload maps such as @loc{Badwater Basin} give more chances.

achievements.description: Assist a Medic in exploding 5 enemies with a single ÜberCharge.
achievements.summary: Help a Medic explode 5 enemies during a single ÜberCharge.

steps.text: Team up with a @enemy{Medic} and ask him to use the @item{Kritzkrieg}, which deals far more damage than the regular ÜberCharge.
Use the standard @item{Rocket Launcher} for its larger splash and ammo, and fire at clustered enemies until 5 have been exploded in that one ÜberCharge.

achievements.description: Kill 500 enemy Soldiers
achievements.summary: Kill 500 enemy Soldiers.

steps.text: Fight enemy @enemy{Soldiers} on your terms: block their line of sight, lay Stickybomb traps and bounce grenades around corners.
Stay at range, since a Soldier's Shotgun and Equalizer hurt more than your melee weapons, and keep going until you have 500 kills.

achievements.description: Destroy 5 enemy Engineer buildings during a single ÜberCharge from a Medic.
achievements.summary: Destroy 5 enemy Engineer buildings in one ÜberCharge given to you by a Medic.

guide.context: The ÜberCharge lasts only 8 seconds, so plan your targets before it starts. Three Stickybombs destroy a building unless its sentry gun is being Wrangled.

steps.text: Team up with a @enemy{Medic} and find an Engineer's nest of at least 5 buildings.
Use the @item{Stickybomb Launcher} during the Medic's ÜberCharge and blow up all 5 buildings before it ends. Avoid the Iron Bomber, Quickiebomb Launcher and Loch-n-Load.
If one building remains, push toward their spawn room and try the Teleporter entrance.

achievements.description: Decapitate a cloaked Spy.
achievements.summary: Decapitate a cloaked Spy.

steps.text: Equip a melee weapon with a blade, like the @item{Eyelander}.
When a cloaked @enemy{Spy} bumps into you or a teammate, draw your blade and chase him. If you know a Spy is near, swing a few times.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with direct hits from the Grenade Launcher.
achievements.summary: Get 50 kills by landing direct hits with the Grenade Launcher.

guide.context: Direct hits from the Loch-n-Load, Loose Cannon and Iron Bomber also count.

steps.text: Aim ahead of enemies, allowing for the arc of your grenades, so they hit the target directly.
Keep scoring direct-hit kills until you reach 50.

achievements.description: Decapitate 50 enemy players.
achievements.summary: Decapitate 50 enemy players.

guide.context: Any bladed melee weapon decapitates.

steps.text: Equip a bladed melee weapon and use a shield charge to reach enemies outside melee range.
Decapitate enemies until you reach 50. The @item{Eyelander}'s head gathering and the @item{Tide Turner}'s recharge on kill help chain kills.

achievements.description: Decapitate 4 players with only 10 seconds between each kill.
achievements.summary: Decapitate 4 players, with no more than 10 seconds between each kill.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Eyelander}, or another melee weapon with a blade, plus a Demoman shield. The @item{Persian Persuader} or @item{Tide Turner} gives more frequent charges.
Charge into a group and decapitate 4 players, each within 10 seconds of the last kill.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies while assisting or being assisted by another Demoman.
achievements.summary: Get 10 kills in which another Demoman assists you or you assist him.

steps.text: Play with another @enemy{Demoman} on your team and attack the same targets with explosives, using the big splash damage.

achievements.description: Decapitate an enemy Soldier who is brandishing the Equalizer.
achievements.summary: Decapitate an enemy Soldier who has the Equalizer equipped.

steps.text: Equip a blade like the @item{Eyelander}, which reaches further than most melee weapons.
Keep your distance from the @enemy{Soldier}, who hits harder when wounded, and decapitate him while he holds the @item{Equalizer}.

achievements.description: Get a melee kill while sticky jumping.
achievements.summary: Kill someone with a melee weapon during a sticky jump.

steps.text: Sticky jump toward a moving enemy, air strafing to reach him.
Kill him with your melee weapon in the air, such as when you hit a midair player or land on an enemy. The @item{B.A.S.E. Jumper} gives more air time.

achievements.description: Destroy an Engineer building that you can't see with a direct hit from your Grenade Launcher.
achievements.summary: Use a direct Grenade Launcher hit to destroy an Engineer building that is out of your sight.

guide.context: Grenades that bounce off walls do not count.

steps.text: Hide behind cover and lob grenades at an enemy building so they hit it directly.
Or fire at a building in plain sight and take cover before the grenades hit. The @item{Loch-n-Load} does extra damage to buildings and its grenades do not bounce.

achievements.description: Dominate 3 Engineers.
achievements.summary: Dominate 3 Engineers.

guide.context: Frontier Justice revenge crits can kill you quickly, so stay careful at close range.

steps.text: Kill Engineer nests and their owners from behind cover with your indirect weapons.
Keep killing the same @enemy{Engineers} until you dominate 3 of them.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy player with stickybombs within 5 seconds of them teleporting.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with Stickybombs within 5 seconds of that enemy teleporting.

steps.text: Place Stickybombs around an enemy Teleporter exit.
Wait for an enemy to use the Teleporter, then detonate the Stickybombs within 5 seconds.

achievements.description: Kill 2 people in a single sticky jump.
achievements.summary: Kill 2 players during a single sticky jump.

guide.context: Kills from Stickybombs that explode together with the one you jump from also count.

steps.text: Sticky jump above a group of enemies and fire Stickybombs down on them in the air.
Detonate them to kill 2 players before you land. The @item{B.A.S.E. Jumper} adds air time for more shots.

achievements.description: Bounce an enemy into the air and kill them before they land.
achievements.summary: Knock an enemy up with an explosion, and kill him before he comes down.

steps.text: Use any explosive weapon to blast an enemy into the air.
Finish him with a grenade or Stickybomb before he lands.

achievements.description: Decapitate your nemesis.
achievements.summary: Decapitate your nemesis.

guide.context: You need a melee weapon with a blade. Choices include the Eyelander, Nessie's Nine Iron, Half-Zatoichi, Claidheamh Mòr, Persian Persuader, Scotsman's Skullcutter and Horseless Headless Horsemann's Headtaker.

steps.text: Sticky jump or use a shield charge to close the distance to your nemesis.
Kill him with a bladed melee weapon.

achievements.description: Do 1 million points of total blast damage.
achievements.summary: Deal a total of 1 million blast damage.

guide.context: Blast damage from the Grenade Launcher, the Stickybomb Launcher and the Ullapool Caber all adds up.

steps.text: Play Demoman and use explosive weapons until your total blast damage reaches 1 million.

achievements.description: Achieve 5 of the achievements in the Demoman pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 5 achievements in the Demoman pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Demoman do not count.

steps.text: Earn Demoman pack achievements until you have 5.

achievements.description: Achieve 11 of the achievements in the Demoman pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 11 achievements in the Demoman pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Demoman pack achievements until you have 11.

achievements.description: Achieve 17 of the achievements in the Demoman pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 17 achievements in the Demoman pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Demoman pack achievements until you have 17.

achievements.description: Blow up an Engineer, his sentry gun, and his dispenser with a single stickybomb detonation.
achievements.summary: Kill an Engineer and destroy his sentry gun and Dispenser in one Stickybomb explosion.

guide.context: A sentry gun protected by the Wrangler needs at most 6 Stickybombs.

steps.text: Spread many Stickybombs around the sentry gun, the Dispenser and the @enemy{Engineer}.
Detonate them all together. If the nest is hard to reach, ask a Medic for an ÜberCharge.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies capping or pushing a cart in a single stickybomb detonation 3 separate times.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies who are capturing a point or pushing a cart with one Stickybomb detonation, 3 separate times.

steps.text: Hide Stickybombs around a control point or along the route of the Payload cart.
Detonate when enough enemies have gathered, killing 3 who are capturing or pushing. Do this 3 times.

achievements.description: Kill 25 players defending a capture point or cart.
achievements.summary: Kill 25 players who are defending a control point or Payload cart.

steps.text: When your team is on the point, shoot grenades at the defenders nearby and place Stickybombs to hold back reinforcements.
Repeat until you have 25 kills.

achievements.description: Destroy 50 buildings.
achievements.summary: Destroy 50 buildings.

steps.text: Use the @item{Stickybomb Launcher} or @item{Scottish Resistance}, since several Stickybombs together can destroy any building.
Work with a Medic to take out difficult sentry guns. Keep destroying buildings until you reach 50.

achievements.description: Kill 3 Heavies from full health with a single stickybomb detonation.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 Heavies, each at full health, in one Stickybomb explosion.

steps.text: Hide a Stickybomb trap away from the main fight, since Heavies in contested areas are seldom at full health.
For an ÜberCharged Heavy, place at least 5 Stickybombs by his feet and explode them once the charge runs out.

achievements.description: Kill 25 Scouts and Pyros with the Grenade Launcher.
achievements.summary: Use the Grenade Launcher to get 25 kills on Scouts and Pyros.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Grenade Launcher} and play as Demoman.
Hit @enemy{Scouts} and @enemy{Pyros} from a distance, leading your shots.
steps.note: Pyros can reflect your grenades and Scouts dodge them, so avoid close range.

achievements.description: Glory in the slaughter of your enemies using the Eyelander.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the Eyelander's taunt.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Eyelander}.
steps.note: Nessie's Nine Iron, Persian Persuader, Half-Zatoichi, Claidheamh Mòr and the Horseless Headless Horsemann's Headtaker have a taunt that works too.

steps.text: Find an enemy who has not noticed you, such as a scoped @enemy{Sniper}.
Stand next to the enemy and use the melee taunt until it kills them.
steps.note: The taunt is slow but quiet, so you can often try again on the same target.

achievements.description: Charge and kill someone with your shield bash.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a shield bash while charging.

steps.text: Equip a shield, such as the @item{Splendid Screen}, which deals the most charge damage.
Charge at a weakened enemy and bash them to kill.
steps.note: Do not swing your melee weapon, because that ends the charge.

achievements.description: Use a critical swing with the Eyelander to kill 5 enemy players.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemy players with critical Eyelander swings.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Eyelander} and any shield.
Swing the Eyelander while charging with your shield for a critical hit.
steps.note: Crits also come from a Kritzkrieg ÜberCharge, holding the enemy Intelligence, or First Blood in Arena.

steps.text: Get 5 kills with critical swings.

achievements.description: Kill 30 players with air burst stickybombs.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 players with stickybombs detonated before they touch the ground.

steps.text: Equip a stickybomb launcher.
Fire stickybombs above enemies and detonate them in the air before they land.
steps.note: The bombs cannot be detonated for about a second after firing.

steps.text: Charge your shots to hit far targets.
steps.note: The @item{Quickiebomb Launcher} charges and detonates faster.

achievements.description: Sticky jump onto a cap point and capture it.
achievements.summary: Sticky jump onto a control point and capture it.

steps.text: Join a standard Control Point map.
Sticky jump onto a point that your team can capture. Detonate stickybombs under your feet to launch yourself.
steps.note: Equip the @item{Pain Train} and ask teammates to help, because you must stay on the point for the whole capture.

steps.text: Stay on the point until it is captured.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy player with a freezecam of your smiling face.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy and taunt so their freeze cam shows your smiling face.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Grenade Launcher}.
steps.note: Other choices are the @item{Saxxy}, @item{Pain Train}, @item{Iron Bomber}, @item{Loose Cannon}, @item{Loch-n-Load} and @item{Scotsman's Skullcutter}.

steps.text: Kill an enemy.
Taunt right after the kill, before you do anything else.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy player with a freezecam of you shaking your rump.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy and taunt so their freeze cam shows you shaking your rump.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Scottish Resistance}.
Kill an enemy.
Taunt right after the kill.

achievements.description: Use the Sticky Launcher to kill an enemy player via environmental damage.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the Stickybomb Launcher through environmental damage, such as a fall or a hazard.

steps.text: Go to a spot near a cliff or pit.
Launch an enemy off the ground with a stickybomb so that a fall or a hazard finishes them.

achievements.description: Destroy 100 enemy stickybombs with the Scottish Resistance.
achievements.summary: Use the Scottish Resistance to destroy 100 stickybombs that belong to the enemy team.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Scottish Resistance}.
Place your stickies at gates and chokepoints, then detonate them to clear enemy stickybombs.
steps.note: On maps with setup time, do this when the round starts. Detonating stickies around corners also defuses unexploded traps.

steps.text: The @item{Quickiebomb Launcher} also counts and arms faster.

achievements.description: Sticky jump a really long way...
achievements.summary: Cover a very long horizontal distance with one sticky jump.

steps.text: Equip a stickybomb launcher and find a long, open stretch.
steps.note: The distance needed is about the span from the first BLU spawn to the first capture point on @loc{Badwater Basin}.

steps.text: Place two or three stickybombs and detonate them in a chain while you fly.
steps.note: The @item{Sticky Jumper} removes the self-damage.

achievements.description: Kill at least three players with a single detonation of stickybombs.
achievements.summary: Kill three or more players with one stickybomb detonation.

steps.text: Hide stickybombs in busy areas, such as around a control point.
Wait until three or more enemies are close to the bombs, then detonate.
Do not use critical stickybombs.
steps.note: Kills made by them do not count.

achievements.description: Kill 20 spies within 5 seconds of them sapping a friendly building.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 Spies, each within 5 seconds of sapping a friendly building.

steps.text: Stay near a friendly Engineer's buildings.
Place stickybombs near the buildings and detonate them when you see or hear a Spy.
steps.note: Without traps, go after the Spy using the @item{Grenade Launcher} or your melee weapon.

steps.text: Repeat until you have 20 kills.

achievements.description: Using the Scottish Resistance, kill 3 players in separate explosions without placing new stickybombs.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 players in separate explosions with the Scottish Resistance, without placing a new stickybomb in between.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Scottish Resistance} and lay traps at several chokepoints.
Detonate each trap by itself as enemies pass, for 3 kills in total.
Do not fire another stickybomb after a kill.
steps.note: This resets your progress.

achievements.description: Use a revenge crit to kill the enemy player that destroyed your sentry gun.
achievements.summary: Kill the enemy who destroyed your sentry gun by using a revenge crit.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Frontier Justice} and build a sentry gun.
After an enemy destroys your sentry, hunt that same enemy and kill them while your revenge crits are active.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies outside the normal sentry gun range using the Wrangler.
achievements.summary: Use the Wrangler to kill 10 enemies beyond the normal range of a sentry gun.

steps.text: Put your sentry gun in a defensive spot and equip the @item{Wrangler}.
Control the sentry with the Wrangler to shoot @enemy{Soldiers} and @enemy{Snipers} who stand out of its normal range.
steps.note: Get 10 kills this way.

achievements.description: Achieve 5 of the achievements in the Engineer pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 5 achievements in the Engineer pack.

guide.context: General achievements earned while playing Engineer do not count.

steps.text: Earn Engineer pack achievements until you have 5.

achievements.description: Achieve 11 of the achievements in the Engineer pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 11 achievements in the Engineer pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Engineer pack achievements until you have 11.

achievements.description: Achieve 17 of the achievements in the Engineer pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 17 achievements in the Engineer pack.

guide.context: Earlier milestones count toward this one.

steps.text: Earn Engineer pack achievements until you have 17.

achievements.description: Teleport 100 team members into battle.
achievements.summary: Teleport 100 team members into battle.

steps.text: Build a teleporter entrance and exit, and upgrade them.
Place the exit close to the fighting.
steps.note: If the entrance and exit are too close together, the teleports do not count.

steps.text: Keep both teleporters running until 100 teammates have used them.

achievements.description: Have dispensers you built extinguish 20 burning players.
achievements.summary: Put out 20 burning players with dispensers that you built.

steps.text: Build a dispenser near the front line.
Stay close and keep it alive while burning teammates come to it, until 20 have been put out.

achievements.description: Kill 3 cloaked Spies with a sentry gun under control of your Wrangler.
achievements.summary: Use the Wrangler to control a sentry gun and kill 3 cloaked Spies with it.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wrangler} and set up a sentry gun.
Watch for the shimmer of a cloaked @enemy{Spy} and aim the sentry at it with the Wrangler.
steps.note: A cloaked Spy who is on fire, bleeding, or covered in Mad Milk or Jarate is easy to spot and counts.

steps.text: Repeat until the sentry has killed 3 cloaked Spies.

achievements.description: Have a sentry shielded by the Wrangler absorb 500 damage without being destroyed.
achievements.summary: Make a sentry gun protected by the Wrangler soak up 500 damage and survive.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wrangler} and shield your sentry gun with it while enemies attack.
Repair the sentry between attacks, and pick it up and run if it is nearly destroyed.
steps.note: The Wrangler only reduces damage taken. It does not give the sentry more health.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with revenge crits without dying.
achievements.summary: Without dying, get 3 kills with revenge crits.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Frontier Justice} and build a sentry gun.
Each time a sentry of yours is destroyed, use the revenge crits to kill enemies who come close.
steps.note: The 3 kills can come from several sentries, but you must not die in between.

steps.text: Stay careful and pick off only enemies who wander near.

achievements.description: Kill a spy and two sappers within 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Kill a Spy and destroy two sappers within 10 seconds.

steps.text: Kill the @enemy{Spy} first so he cannot place more sappers.
Destroy the two sappers on your buildings quickly.
steps.note: The clock starts when the first of the three is eliminated. Removing both sappers takes about five seconds.

achievements.description: Kill a disguised spy with your Wrench.
achievements.summary: Kill a Spy who is in disguise using your Wrench.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wrench}.
Hit teammates who look suspicious, and keep hitting any who turn out to be a disguised @enemy{Spy} until he dies.

achievements.description: Upgrade 50 buildings built by other team members.
achievements.summary: Upgrade 50 buildings that other team members built.

steps.text: Find a building a teammate just built and hit it with your @item{Wrench} to upgrade it.
Repeat on other Engineers' buildings until you have upgraded 50.
steps.note: The upgrade counts only if your own wrench hit causes it.

achievements.description: Destroy 25 sappers on buildings built by other team members.
achievements.summary: Destroy 25 sappers on buildings that other team members built.

steps.text: Stay near friendly Engineers' buildings, especially ones whose owners are away.
When a @enemy{Spy} saps one, destroy the sapper. Do this 25 times.

achievements.description: Repair a sentry gun under fire while being healed by a Medic.
achievements.summary: While a Medic heals you, repair a sentry gun that is being shot at.

steps.text: Build a sentry gun in a spot enemies are attacking.
Ask a @npc{Medic} to heal you, then repair the sentry while it is under fire.

achievements.description: Rack up 5000 kills with your sentry guns.
achievements.summary: Get 5000 kills with your sentry guns.

steps.text: Play as Engineer and keep a sentry gun active in a busy spot.
Keep rebuilding and moving it until its kills reach 5000 in total.

achievements.description: Have your sentry kill the enemy that just killed you within 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Have your sentry gun kill the enemy who just killed you within 10 seconds.

steps.text: Stay near your sentry gun while enemies attack.
If an enemy kills you, the sentry must still be alive and kill that enemy within 10 seconds.
steps.note: Enemies may target you instead of the sentry, so the sentry must survive to finish your killer.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy player with a freezecam of your guitar playing skills.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy and taunt so their freeze cam shows you playing the guitar.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Frontier Justice}.
Kill an enemy yourself, then taunt right away.
steps.note: Sentry kills do not count, even when you appear in the freeze cam.

achievements.description: Provide an enemy player with a freezecam of you and the sentry that just killed them.
achievements.summary: Have a sentry gun kill an enemy while you stand next to it, so their freeze cam shows you both.

steps.text: Build a sentry gun where enemies pass.
Stand next to it until it kills an enemy.

achievements.description: Use your shotgun to finish off an enemy recently damaged by your sentry gun.
achievements.summary: Finish off an enemy with your shotgun after your sentry gun recently hurt them.

steps.text: Stand near your sentry gun with your shotgun equipped.
Shoot the enemy your sentry is firing at and kill them before the sentry does.
steps.note: Revenge crits from the @item{Frontier Justice} lower the chance that the sentry takes the kill.

achievements.description: Have a dispenser heal 3 teammates at the same time.
achievements.summary: Have a dispenser heal 3 teammates at the same time.

steps.text: Build a dispenser at the front line, where many teammates are hurt.
Wait until 3 teammates stand in its range together.

achievements.description: Use a sentry gun to kill 25 enemy players that are capturing a point.
achievements.summary: Get 25 sentry gun kills on enemy players while they are capturing a point.

steps.text: Place your sentry gun where it guards the paths into the capture area, at a control point or along the Payload cart route.
Let the sentry kill enemies as they capture. Use the @item{Wrangler} to reach any it cannot.
steps.note: Get 25 kills this way.

achievements.description: Kill 20 players carrying the intelligence.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 players who are carrying the intelligence.

steps.text: Join a map where teams steal an intelligence.
Place your sentry gun on the routes enemy runners use to escape.
Chase any runner who gets past with your shotgun and pistol, for 20 kills in total.

achievements.description: Pick up 10,000 waste metal from pieces of destroyed buildings.
achievements.summary: Collect 10,000 waste metal from the pieces left by destroyed buildings.

steps.text: After a building is destroyed, walk over the metal pieces it drops.
Keep picking up pieces until you have collected 10,000 waste metal.

achievements.description: Help a teammate construct a building.
achievements.summary: Help a teammate construct a building.

steps.text: Find a teammate's building that is still being built.
Hit it with your melee weapon until it finishes.

achievements.description: Manage to get to and then remove a sapper placed on your building while you were several meters away.
achievements.summary: Run to a sapper on your building and remove it, after it was placed while you were several meters from the building.

steps.text: Leave your buildings and stay several meters away.
When a @enemy{Spy} saps a building, run to it and destroy the sapper.

achievements.description: Destroy 50 enemy stickybombs lying in range of friendly buildings.
achievements.summary: Destroy 50 enemy stickybombs that are lying near friendly buildings.

steps.text: Guard friendly buildings and shoot or hit any enemy stickybombs near them.
Do not use the @item{Short Circuit}.
steps.note: Stickybombs it destroys do not count.

achievements.description: Smash an enemy player's head in with your guitar.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the guitar taunt.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Frontier Justice}.
Find an enemy who has not noticed you, such as a scoped @enemy{Sniper}.
Stand next to them and use the taunt until the guitar smash lands.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Snipers with a sentry gun under control of your Wrangler.
achievements.summary: Use a Wrangler-controlled sentry gun to kill 10 Snipers.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wrangler} and set up a sentry gun with a view of enemy @enemy{Snipers}.
Aim the sentry at Snipers with the Wrangler and keep moving to avoid headshots.
steps.note: Kills from sentry rockets fired through the Wrangler do not count.

steps.text: If a Sniper cannot be hit from far away, sneak up on him with a @item{Combat Mini-sentry gun}.

achievements.description: Perform 50 repairs and/or reloads on a Sentry gun being Wrangled by another Engineer.
achievements.summary: Repair or reload a sentry gun that another Engineer is controlling with the Wrangler, 50 times.

steps.text: Team up with a friendly Engineer who uses the @item{Wrangler}.
Repair and reload their sentry gun while they control it, for 50 repairs or reloads in total.

achievements.description: Destroy an enemy Engineer's sentry gun with a sentry under control of your Wrangler.
achievements.summary: Use your Wrangler-controlled sentry gun to destroy an enemy Engineer's sentry gun.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Wrangler} and haul your sentry gun to a spot where you can hit an enemy Engineer's sentry from a distance.
Aim your sentry at the enemy sentry with the Wrangler until it is destroyed.
steps.note: Destroying a Combat Mini-Sentry does not count.

achievements.displayName: If You Build It, They Will Die
achievements.description: Haul a level 3 sentry gun into a position where it achieves a kill shortly after being redeployed.
achievements.summary: Haul a level 3 sentry gun to a new spot and get a kill with it within 10 seconds of putting it down.

steps.text: Build and upgrade a sentry gun to level 3.
Pick it up, carry it to a spot where enemies are fighting, and put it down.
Defend it so it kills an enemy within 10 seconds.
steps.note: Repair it as needed.

achievements.description: Haul buildings 1 km over your career.
achievements.summary: Haul buildings a total distance of 1 km.

steps.text: Play as Engineer and pick up your buildings to move them around the map.
Keep carrying them until the total distance reaches 1 km.

achievements.description: Get 10 assists with another Engineer where a sentry gun was involved in the kill.
achievements.summary: Get 10 assists with another Engineer on kills that involved a sentry gun.

steps.text: Join a friendly Engineer who defends a key area or chokepoint.
Help defend their sentry gun with your shotgun to earn the assists.

achievements.description: Have dispensers you created dispense a combined amount of 100,000 health over your career.
achievements.summary: Have your dispensers heal a total of 100,000 health.

steps.text: Build a dispenser near the front line, where many teammates are hurt.
Move it forward as your team advances, until the total reaches 100,000.

achievements.description: Repair 50,000 damage to friendly buildings constructed by other players.
achievements.summary: Repair a total of 50,000 damage on friendly buildings built by other players.

steps.text: Stay near allied Engineers' buildings, especially ones under fire.
Repair them with your @item{Wrench} until you have repaired 50,000 damage.

achievements.description: Help a single building tank over 2000 damage without being destroyed.
achievements.summary: Have a single building take over 2000 damage without being destroyed.

steps.text: Upgrade a sentry gun to level 3.
Place it in a contested spot and repair it between attacks.
steps.note: Pick it up and move it away if it looks close to destruction.

achievements.description: Keep a Heavy healed with your dispenser while he gains 5 kills.
achievements.summary: Keep a Heavy healed by your dispenser while he gets 5 kills.

steps.text: Build a dispenser near the fighting.
Ask a @npc{Heavy} to stay in the dispenser beam while he fights.
steps.note: If he leaves the beam, the count starts over.

steps.text: Keep the dispenser alive until he gets 5 kills.

achievements.description: Kill the Horseless Headless Horsemann.
achievements.summary: Kill the @enemy{Horseless Headless Horsemann}.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running. Everyone who damages him in the 5 seconds before he dies gets the achievement.

steps.text: Join a server running a Halloween map and wait for the @enemy{Horseless Headless Horsemann} to spawn.
Hit him with your team until he dies. A fast class such as @mechanic{Scout} can pull him around the map, and a high-damage class such as @mechanic{Soldier} speeds up the kill.

achievements.description: Collect a Soul Gargoyle in Mann Manor.
achievements.summary: Pick up a Soul Gargoyle on @loc{Mann Manor}.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running. A Soul Gargoyle only appears when the server has at least 10 players.

steps.text: Play on @loc{Mann Manor} on a server with at least 10 players.
When a Soul Gargoyle is announced for you, find it and pick it up before an enemy kills you.

achievements.description: Craft the Saxton Hale Mask.
achievements.summary: Craft the Saxton Hale Mask.

guide.context: You can earn this at any time of the year.

steps.text: Get the Halloween Mask for each of the nine classes.
Craft all nine masks together to make the @item{Saxton Hale Mask}.

achievements.description: Collect the Horseless Headless Horsemann's Haunted Metal.
achievements.summary: Hit the @enemy{Horseless Headless Horsemann} with a melee weapon just before he dies, to collect his Haunted Metal Scrap.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: Help your team bring the @enemy{Horseless Headless Horsemann} to low health.
Switch to your melee weapon. When he starts to shiver, move in and land a melee hit before he dies.

achievements.description: Save your very first replay.
achievements.summary: Save your first replay.

guide.context: Replays do not work on official Casual servers, so use a community server that shows the replay icon.

steps.text: Open the server browser, choose Community Servers, turn on the Replay Support filter, and join any listed server.
Press F6, name the replay, and save it.
Die, or type @mechanic{kill} in the console, then wait until the replay has downloaded.

achievements.displayName: We Can Fix It In Post
achievements.description: While watching a replay, press space bar to enter the editor.
achievements.summary: Press the space bar while watching a replay to open the replay editor.

steps.text: On the main menu, click the TV icon at the bottom right, click your replay, and choose Watch/Edit.
Once the replay starts, press the space bar to open the editor.

achievements.displayName: Time For Your Close-Up, Mr. Hale
achievements.description: Render a replay into a movie.
achievements.summary: Render a replay into a movie.

guide.context: Since the 64-bit update this only works in the 32-bit game. This method uses changed game files, and achievement tracker sites may flag it.

steps.text: Install Apple's QuickTime. You can remove it after you get the achievement.
Close TF2. In Steam, right-click TF2, choose Properties, then Installed Files, then Browse. Open the application named @item{tf}, not @item{tf_win64}.
On the main menu, open Replays, click your replay, choose Save To Movie, leave the settings alone, and click Go!
Wait until the movie finishes saving. The achievement unlocks when it is done.

achievements.description: Complete each class to unlock the next.
achievements.summary: Complete the training course for every class, including both parts of Soldier training.

guide.context: If you finished training before this achievement existed, redo the Soldier training, including the part on Dustbowl.

steps.text: Play the training course for every class until each one is complete.
For Soldier, finish both parts of training, including the part on @loc{Dustbowl}.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy within 5 seconds of you traveling through an Engineer's teleporter.
achievements.summary: Get a kill within 5 seconds of exiting an Engineer's teleporter.

guide.context: A telefrag, a sentry gun kill, or a normal kill all count.

steps.text: Ask an Engineer on your team to build a teleporter with its exit near the enemy, then use the entrance.
Get your kill within 5 seconds of stepping out of the exit.

achievements.description: Achieve 100 YouTube™ views for your movie.
achievements.summary: Reach 100 YouTube views on a replay movie.

guide.context: You need a rendered replay first. This method edits a game file, and achievement tracker sites may flag it.

steps.text: Close TF2. In the TF2 install folder, open @item{tf}, then @item{replay}, then @item{client}, then @item{movies}.
Open the .dmx file for your rendered replay in Notepad. Your first replay is usually @item{movie_10000.dmx}.

Change the @item{uploaded} value to 1. Add a new line below it with the key @item{upload_url} and this address as its value: @item{http://pastebin.com/raw/jbefh0vS}. Copy the spacing of the other lines.
Save the file, start TF2, open Replays, and click that replay. All four YouTube achievements unlock together.

achievements.description: Achieve 1000 YouTube™ views for your movie.
achievements.summary: Reach 1,000 YouTube views on a replay movie.

guide.context: You need a rendered replay first. This method edits a game file, and achievement tracker sites may flag it.

achievements.description: Achieve 10,000 YouTube™ views for your movie.
achievements.summary: Reach 10,000 YouTube views on a replay movie.

guide.context: You need a rendered replay first. This method edits a game file, and achievement tracker sites may flag it.

steps.text: Close TF2. In the TF2 install folder, open @item{tf}, then @item{replay}, then @item{client}, then @item{movies}.
Open the .dmx file for your rendered replay in Notepad. Your first replay is usually @item{movie_10000.dmx}.

achievements.description: Achieve 100,000 YouTube™ views for your movie.
achievements.summary: Reach 100,000 YouTube views on a replay movie.

guide.context: You need a rendered replay first. This method edits a game file, and achievement tracker sites may flag it.

steps.text: Close TF2. In the TF2 install folder, open @item{tf}, then @item{replay}, then @item{client}, then @item{movies}.
Open the .dmx file for your rendered replay in Notepad. Your first replay is usually @item{movie_10000.dmx}.
