achievements.description: Spend some time editing a replay.
achievements.summary: Use the replay editor for 3 minutes without idling.

guide.context: If you go a full minute without pressing the space bar, the 3 minutes start over.

steps.text: Open a saved replay with Watch/Edit and press the space bar to open the editor.
Keep working in the editor for 3 minutes: select each class, press the buttons along the bottom, and move the sliders, including the free-camera slider at the bottom of the screen.

achievements.description: Jump into a pool of refreshing water while on fire.
achievements.summary: Jump into a pool of water while you are on fire.

guide.context: Shallow water like the Hydro rivers will not work.

steps.text: Get set on fire, then jump into a deep pool of water.

achievements.description: Kill MONOCULUS!
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{MONOCULUS}.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running. MONOCULUS stays for 90 seconds, and the last three players to damage him get the achievement. It does not work on Hellstone.

steps.text: Join a server running a Halloween map and wait for @enemy{MONOCULUS} to appear.
Shoot him with a class that hits airborne targets, such as @mechanic{Scout} or @mechanic{Soldier}. Weapons that fire fast, like the Minigun and Flamethrower, do little.
When he teleports, enter the portal he leaves, cross the Underworld, and attack him when you return. Your hits stun him.

achievements.description: Get to Loot Island and claim your reward!
achievements.summary: Reach Loot Island and jump into the spooky book there.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running. Enemies can use the portal too.

steps.text: Play on @loc{Eyeaduct} until @enemy{MONOCULUS} is killed, then enter the purple portal he leaves. You do not need to help kill him.
Go up the stairs, let the cage come down, then leap into the book.

achievements.description: Collect three gifts dropped by opponents.
achievements.summary: Pick up three gifts dropped by opponents.

guide.context: Only works while the Christmas event is running.

steps.text: Kill enemies and pick up any Christmas gift one of them drops. Do this three times.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy who is capturing a control point with a critical hit.
achievements.summary: On Foundry, get a critical-hit kill on an enemy who is in the middle of capturing a control point.

steps.text: Play @loc{Foundry} and use a way to get a sure critical hit, such as the @item{Backburner}, @item{Frontier Justice}, a Sniper headshot, a @item{Kritzkrieg} charge, or a Spy backstab.
Kill an enemy while he is capturing a control point.

achievements.description: Play in a game with five or more players from your Friends list.
achievements.summary: On Foundry, finish a full round while at least five players from your friends list are in the game.

steps.text: Bring at least five of your Steam friends into one @loc{Foundry} server.
Play one full round together.

achievements.description: Be part of a team that wins within two minutes.
achievements.summary: Be on the team that wins a round on Foundry within two minutes.

guide.context: Your team usually has to capture points three, four and five one after another. A lost fight over the center point costs too much time.

steps.text: Play @loc{Foundry} with a team that starts the round strongly.
Take points three, four and five back to back to finish in under two minutes.

achievements.description: Win 137 Rounds.
achievements.summary: Win 137 rounds on Foundry.

steps.text: Keep playing @loc{Foundry} and win rounds until your wins reach 137.

achievements.description: Capture the final control point within five seconds of your team capturing the previous control point.
achievements.summary: Capture the last control point on Foundry no more than 5 seconds after your team takes the one before it.

steps.text: While your team fights for the fourth point, run ahead to the last one. A @mechanic{Scout} is the fastest, and a @mechanic{Spy} can sneak past enemies.
Start capturing the final point the moment your team captures the fourth.

achievements.description: Capture a control point within 12 seconds after exiting a teleporter.
achievements.summary: Capture a control point on Foundry within 12 seconds after leaving a teleporter.

steps.text: As Engineer, build a teleporter exit close to a contested control point, or use one built by a teammate.
Teleport to the exit and start capturing the point right away. If it is not the last point, wait until your teammates have partly captured it first.

achievements.description: Kill a player by pushing them into the cauldron fire.
achievements.summary: Kill a player on Foundry by pushing him into the cauldron fire.

guide.context: You must get the kill credit for the push.

steps.text: Fight near a final control point, where the cauldron fire sits on a raised platform behind it.
Push an enemy into the fire with any knockback. A @mechanic{Pyro} compression blast is the easiest way.

achievements.description: Win a round in which the enemy team has attempted to capture your final control point.
achievements.summary: Win a round on Foundry after the enemy team has tried to capture your final control point.

steps.text: On @loc{Foundry}, defend your final control point after the enemy starts to capture it.
Push back and win the round.

achievements.description: Get one or more kills as all nine classes in one round.
achievements.summary: Get at least one kill with each of the nine classes in a single round on Foundry.

guide.context: The round has to last long enough for nine kills and nine class changes.

steps.text: Get a kill, then switch class right away. Repeat until you have a kill with all nine classes in the same round.

achievements.description: Kill two people on the roof of the center control point in a single life.
achievements.summary: On Foundry, kill two enemies standing on the center control point's roof in one life.

guide.context: Enemies rarely fight on the roof, so you may have to wait for them.

steps.text: Play @loc{Foundry} and watch the roof above the center control point. A @mechanic{Scout}, @mechanic{Soldier}, or @mechanic{Demoman} can jump up, and a @mechanic{Sniper} can shoot from afar.
Kill two enemies there without dying.

achievements.description: Play through a back-and-forth battle for 15 control point captures.
achievements.summary: On Foundry, play a seesaw fight until 15 control point captures have happened.

guide.context: Both teams must be evenly matched and keep attacking.

steps.text: Play @loc{Foundry} and push for captures while the other team captures back, until 15 captures have been made.

achievements.description: Achieve 7 of the achievements in the Foundry pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 7 achievements in the Foundry pack.

steps.text: Earn any 7 other Foundry achievements. The milestone unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Complete all waves successfully in a mission.
achievements.summary: Complete all waves of one Mann vs. Machine mission.

guide.context: A coordinated team on Normal difficulty is the easiest way.

steps.text: Join a Mann vs. Machine mission and survive every wave until the mission is complete.

achievements.description: Pick up the Australium from its home position and capture it without dropping it.
achievements.summary: On Doomsday, take the Australium from its starting spot and capture it with no drops.

guide.context: It is much easier on an empty server.

steps.text: On @loc{Doomsday}, grab the Australium at the start of the round, or after it resets to its home position.
Carry it to the rocket without dropping it. Stay near teammates who guard you, and keep moving. A @mechanic{Scout} is fast, and a @mechanic{Heavy} with a @mechanic{Medic} is sturdy.

achievements.description: Play in a game with five or more players from your Friends list.
achievements.summary: On Doomsday, finish a game while at least five players from your friends list are in it.

steps.text: Bring at least five of your Steam friends into one @loc{Doomsday} server, or join a server where some already play.

achievements.description: Win 138 Rounds.
achievements.summary: Win 138 rounds on Doomsday.

steps.text: Keep playing @loc{Doomsday} and win rounds until your wins reach 138.

achievements.description: Launch the rocket as all 9 classes.
achievements.summary: Launch the rocket on Doomsday as each of the 9 classes.

steps.text: Pick a class on @loc{Doomsday} and play it until you launch the rocket.
Repeat with each of the other eight classes until all nine have launched the rocket.

achievements.description: Kill 3 players riding the elevator within 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: On Doomsday, kill three players on the elevator inside a 10-second window.

steps.text: Wait until the enemy team starts raising the elevator on @loc{Doomsday}.

Kill three riders within 10 seconds. A @mechanic{Soldier} or @mechanic{Demoman} can explosive jump to the platform, a @mechanic{Pyro} or @mechanic{Heavy} can leap from high ground, and a @mechanic{Sniper} can shoot from afar.

achievements.description: Win a round after the enemy team has opened the rocket lid.
achievements.summary: On Doomsday, win the round even though the other team already opened the rocket lid.

steps.text: When the enemy raises the elevator and starts to open the rocket lid, kill their Australium carrier before the capture finishes.
Guard the Australium until it goes back to the drop site, then take it and capture it yourself to win the round.

achievements.description: Kill 6 enemies carrying the Australium during the same round.
achievements.summary: On Doomsday, kill 6 Australium carriers from the enemy team within one round.

guide.context: The round has to last a long time, and it goes best when both teams are evenly matched.

steps.text: Keep killing enemy Australium carriers until you have 6 in one round on @loc{Doomsday}.

achievements.description: Win a round with at least 5 teammates on the elevator.
achievements.summary: On Doomsday, win a round while 5 or more teammates ride the elevator.

steps.text: Ask at least 5 teammates to ride the elevator with the Australium carrier.
Watch every angle while you ride: jumps from high ground, stray explosives, and long Sniper shots. Win the round.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy within the broken crate area while they attempt to pick up the neutral Australium.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy in the broken crate area while he tries to pick up the neutral Australium on Doomsday.

guide.context: At the start of a round the neutral Australium can only be picked up after 45 seconds.

steps.text: Stay near the broken crate area on @loc{Doomsday} until the neutral Australium can be picked up.
Kill an enemy who stands on the Australium to pick it up.

achievements.description: Push a player into the rocket's exhaust path at the end of the round.
achievements.summary: On Doomsday, knock a player into the rocket exhaust as the round ends.

steps.text: As the round ends on @loc{Doomsday}, fight an enemy under the rocket where the exhaust fumes spread.
Push him into the exhaust path. Knockback from the @item{Force-A-Nature} or a @mechanic{Pyro} compression blast helps.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy who has damaged the Australium carrier in the last 3 seconds.
achievements.summary: On Doomsday, kill an enemy who hurt the Australium carrier less than 3 seconds ago.

steps.text: Guard your team's Australium carrier on @loc{Doomsday} and kill any enemy who attacks him.
Or carry it yourself and kill an enemy who damages you.

achievements.description: Achieve 7 of the achievements in the Doomsday pack.
achievements.summary: Earn 7 achievements in the Doomsday pack.

steps.text: Earn any 7 other Doomsday achievements. The milestone unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Kill 79 enemies who have Balloonicorn pets.
achievements.summary: Kill 79 enemies who have a Balloonicorn pet.

guide.context: The Balloonicorn only shows and counts while Pyrovision is on. The Reindoonicorn and Balloonicorpse also count, and so does a Spy disguised as a player who has one.

steps.text: Turn on Pyrovision and play a map that supports it, such as @loc{2Fort}.
Kill enemies who have a Balloonicorn pet until you reach 79 kills.

achievements.description: Have 2 BEST FRIENDS at the same time.
achievements.summary: Dominate two players at the same time while wearing the Pyrovision Goggles.

steps.text: Put on the @item{Pyrovision Goggles}.
Dominate one player, then a second player while the first domination is still active. Avoid the first player until you finish the second.

achievements.description: Have 6 teammates using Pyrovision at the same time.
achievements.summary: Get 6 teammates into Pyrovision simultaneously.

guide.context: This only works if your in-game name has no spaces.

steps.text: Change your in-game name so it has no spaces.
Get 6 teammates into Pyrovision at the same time. Gather friends, or play a Pyrovision map such as @loc{2Fort}.

achievements.description: Dominate a player using the Pyrovision Goggles and earn your own pair!
achievements.summary: Dominate a player who has Pyrovision Goggles on.

steps.text: Find a player wearing @item{Pyrovision Goggles}. They are common on maps that support Pyrovision, such as @loc{2Fort}.
Keep killing that player until you dominate him.

achievements.description: Ignite 3 enemy players using your Rainblower taunt.
achievements.summary: Ignite 3 enemy players with your Rainblower taunt.

guide.context: A kill does not count as an ignite, so all three must live through the hit.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Rainblower} as your Pyro primary weapon.
Taunt in a crowded spot, ideally with teammates covering you, because the taunt takes a long time to finish.

achievements.description: Earn a credit bonus at the end of a wave.
achievements.summary: Get the credit bonus that pays out when a Mann vs. Machine wave ends.

steps.text: In a Mann vs. Machine wave, pick up every credit pile the robots drop. A @mechanic{Scout} is good at this, and keeping robots near their spawn or the bomb hatch makes it easier.

achievements.description: Earn all credit bonuses in an advanced difficulty mission.
achievements.summary: Earn every credit bonus in one advanced difficulty Mann vs. Machine mission.

guide.context: An Intermediate difficulty mission also works.

steps.text: In a Mann vs. Machine mission, pick up every credit pile the robots drop in every wave. Use a @mechanic{Scout} to collect, and hold the robots in one spot, like their spawn or the drop-off point.

achievements.description: Pick up a credit pile that is about to expire.
achievements.summary: Pick up a credit pile in Mann vs. Machine that is about to expire.

steps.text: In a Mann vs. Machine wave, pick up a credit pile once it starts flickering, before it disappears.

achievements.description: Collect 1,000,000 credits in your career.
achievements.summary: Over your career, collect a total of 1,000,000 credits in Mann vs. Machine.

steps.text: Keep playing Mann vs. Machine missions and picking up credits. The total builds over many missions.

achievements.description: Complete a mission with 5 people on your Friends List.
achievements.summary: Complete a Mann vs. Machine mission with 5 people from your friends list.

steps.text: Before the first round of a Mann vs. Machine mission, make sure your whole team is made up of people from your friends list.
Finish the mission together without anyone leaving partway.

achievements.description: Play an entire mission as a single class, and do this for every class.
achievements.summary: Complete a Mann vs. Machine mission as every class, never switching classes between the first wave and the last.

steps.text: Pick one class before the first wave of a Mann vs. Machine mission and keep it until the last wave ends.
Repeat in new Mann vs. Machine missions with a different class each time until all nine classes are done.

achievements.description: Destroy two tanks within 5 seconds of each other.
achievements.summary: Kill two tanks in Mann vs. Machine with no more than 5 seconds between them.

guide.context: Only some waves spawn two tanks one after the other.

steps.text: Pick a Mann vs. Machine wave that sends two tanks close together and set up near the robot spawn.
Bring the first tank down to critical health without destroying it. You may need to let it pass your line so you can hit the second tank as soon as it spawns.
Bring the second tank down to critical health the same way.
Split your team and destroy both tanks at the same time.

achievements.description: Destroy the tank during the final seconds of the bomb being deployed.
achievements.summary: Destroy a tank in Mann vs. Machine during the last seconds of its bomb deployment.

steps.text: In a Mann vs. Machine wave with a tank, damage the tank to a sliver of health but do not destroy it.
Let it walk to the bomb hatch while your team deals with the other robots.
Once the tank has pulled out the bomb and is arming it, destroy it. Use a @item{Kritzkrieg} or a Crit Boost canteen if you need more damage.

achievements.description: Destroy a tank within 20 seconds of its arrival.
achievements.summary: Destroy a tank in Mann vs. Machine within 20 seconds of its arrival.

guide.context: A tank destroys any sentry gun it runs into.

steps.text: As soon as a tank spawns in Mann vs. Machine, have the whole team shoot it. Use a @item{Kritzkrieg} or Crit Boost canteens.
Putting a sentry gun or stickybombs close to the spawn point adds damage early on.

achievements.description: During a wave, defend the hatch 10 times from robots about to deliver a bomb.
achievements.summary: During a Mann vs. Machine wave, destroy a bomb carrier that is about to deliver the bomb at the hatch, 10 times.

steps.text: In a Mann vs. Machine wave, set your defense around the bomb hatch. A dropped bomb stays there.
When a carrier reaches the hatch and starts its arming animation, destroy it. Keep doing this until you have done it 10 times.

achievements.description: In a single wave, kill 15 bomb-carrying robots in a row before they level up.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 bomb carriers one after another in a single Mann vs. Machine wave, before any of them levels up.

guide.context: A taunting carrier levels up. In a wave with few robots, leave the others alive so they pick up the bomb.

steps.text: In a Mann vs. Machine wave, kill every robot that picks up the bomb before it taunts.
Keep going until you have killed 15 carriers in a row.

achievements.description: Defeat a wave in an advanced difficulty mission without dying once.
achievements.summary: Complete a wave of an advanced Mann vs. Machine mission without dying.

steps.text: Start an advanced Mann vs. Machine mission and play the first wave carefully, away from the heaviest fighting.
Stay alive until the wave ends.

achievements.description: Complete the Crash Course, Doe's Drill, and Mann-euvers missions.
achievements.summary: Beat three Mann vs. Machine missions: Mann-euvers, Doe's Drill and Crash Course.

guide.context: Normal difficulty with a coordinated team makes each mission easier.

steps.text: Complete the Crash Course mission in Mann vs. Machine.
Complete the Doe's Drill mission in Mann vs. Machine.
Complete the Mann-euvers mission in Mann vs. Machine.

achievements.description: Use a canteen charged with 'Teleport to Spawn' and then kill the bomb carrier within 5 seconds.
achievements.summary: Use a Mann vs. Machine canteen charged with Teleport to Spawn, and kill the bomb carrier no more than 5 seconds later.

steps.text: In Mann vs. Machine, charge a canteen with Teleport to Spawn.
When a bomb carrier gets past your team near the drop-off point, use the canteen.
Kill the carrier within 5 seconds. A sentry gun or a @item{Stickybomb Launcher} can do the kill after you use the canteen.

achievements.description: Use a canteen charged with 'Crit Boost' to destroy a giant robot.
achievements.summary: Use a Crit Boost canteen to destroy a giant robot in Mann vs. Machine.

steps.text: In Mann vs. Machine, charge a canteen with Crit Boost.
When a giant robot is in range, use the canteen and destroy the giant with a strong weapon.

achievements.description: Use a canteen charged with 'ÜberCharge' to destroy 15 robots.
achievements.summary: Use a Mann vs. Machine canteen charged with ÜberCharge to destroy 15 robots.

guide.context: The ÜberCharge canteen lasts only 5 seconds.

steps.text: In Mann vs. Machine, charge a canteen with ÜberCharge and play a class that hits many enemies at once, such as Heavy, Pyro, Demoman or Soldier.
When a large group of weak robots, such as Scouts, closes in, use the canteen and destroy 15 robots before it ends.

achievements.description: During a wave, use a canteen charged with 'Instant Building Upgrade' to build a new sentry gun within 3 seconds of your previous sentry gun's destruction.
achievements.summary: After your sentry gun is destroyed in a Mann vs. Machine wave, use an Instant Building Upgrade canteen to get a new one built inside 3 seconds.

steps.text: As an Engineer in Mann vs. Machine, charge a canteen with Instant Building Upgrade.
When robots or a Sentry Buster destroy your sentry gun, use the canteen and put up a new sentry gun inside 3 seconds.

achievements.description: During a wave, use a canteen charged with 'Ammo Reload' to refill an empty weapon slot.
achievements.summary: During a Mann vs. Machine wave, use an Ammo Reload canteen to refill an empty weapon slot.

steps.text: In Mann vs. Machine, charge a canteen with Ammo Reload and use a weapon that runs dry quickly, like the @item{Rocket Launcher}, @item{Minigun} or @item{Huntsman}.
When a weapon slot is empty during a wave, use the canteen.

achievements.description: Max out all primary weapon upgrades.
achievements.summary: Max out all upgrades on your primary weapon in Mann vs. Machine.

guide.context: The Engineer's primary weapon is the Construction PDA. The Caliginous Caper mission gives enough credits at the start to max a weapon.

steps.text: In Mann vs. Machine, spend your credits on every upgrade for your primary weapon until all are maxed.
If it does not unlock, switch your loadout before the mission starts to respawn and wipe your upgrades, then try again.

achievements.description: Max out all resistances on a single class.
achievements.summary: Buy every resistance upgrade for one class in Mann vs. Machine.

steps.text: In Mann vs. Machine, get 2700 credits, either over a normal mission or at the start of Caliginous Caper.
Buy every resistance upgrade for one class. You can refund the upgrades right afterward and keep playing normally.

achievements.description: Prevent the bomb from ever reaching an alarm zone during the final wave of an advanced difficulty mission.
achievements.summary: In the last wave of an advanced Mann vs. Machine mission, keep the bomb from ever getting to an alarm zone.

steps.text: In the final wave of an advanced Mann vs. Machine mission, hold bomb carriers back near the robot spawn with knockback, slowdown and high-damage weapons.
It is fine if other robots get past you, as long as the bomb is not with them.

achievements.description: Kill 5 Medics that are ready to deploy an ÜberCharge in a wave.
achievements.summary: In one Mann vs. Machine wave, kill 5 robot Medics whose ÜberCharge is ready to go.

guide.context: Robot Medics charge by healing and deploy when they or their patient take damage. Many waves have at most 10 of them, so your team may need to hold fire for a moment to let them charge.

steps.text: In a Mann vs. Machine wave, watch for a robot Medic that crackles, which means its ÜberCharge is full.
Destroy it in one hit before it deploys the ÜberCharge. Repeat until 5 Medics are done.

achievements.description: Destroy 100,000 robots.
achievements.summary: Destroy 100,000 robots in Mann vs. Machine.

guide.context: Caliginous Caper has the highest average robot count, about 911 per mission.

steps.text: Keep playing Mann vs. Machine missions until you have destroyed 100,000 robots in total.

achievements.description: Destroy 1,000,000 robots.
achievements.summary: Destroy 1,000,000 robots in Mann vs. Machine.

guide.context: Caliginous Caper has the highest average robot count, about 911 per mission, which works out to about 1,100 missions.

steps.text: Keep playing Mann vs. Machine missions until you have destroyed 1,000,000 robots in total.

achievements.description: Destroy a sentry buster before it reaches its target.
achievements.summary: Destroy a Sentry Buster in Mann vs. Machine before it reaches its target.

guide.context: A Sentry Buster only appears when a sentry gun is contributing to the fight. The @item{Rescue Ranger} can haul a building from far away if you have at least 100 metal.

steps.text: In Mann vs. Machine, have your team focus on the @enemy{Sentry Buster} and deal as much damage as possible.
Slow it or knock it back with upgraded @item{Mad Milk}, upgraded @item{Jarate} or the Pyro compression blast so it does not reach the sentry gun.
As an Engineer, you can haul your sentry gun away and let the Buster chase you while your team destroys it.

achievements.description: As a Spy, sap 10 robots at once.
achievements.summary: As a Spy in Mann vs. Machine, sap 10 robots at once.

guide.context: The Sapper does not recharge instantly in this mode.

steps.text: As a Spy in Mann vs. Machine, wait for a large group of robots.
Place the Sapper on a robot in the middle of the group so it affects 10 robots at once. Upgrade the Sapper range to help.

achievements.description: Buff 4 or more teammates as a Soldier at the same time in a single wave.
achievements.summary: As a Soldier in Mann vs. Machine, give your buff to 4 or more teammates at once during one wave.

steps.text: As a Soldier in Mann vs. Machine, deal splash damage to robots to charge your banner.
Stay close to your team, or upgrade the banner range, then use the banner when 4 or more teammates are in range.

achievements.description: During a wave, use rage as a Heavy to push a robot about to deliver the bomb.
achievements.summary: As a Heavy in Mann vs. Machine, use Rage during a wave to push a robot that is about to deliver the bomb.

guide.context: Taunting with a full Rage meter skips the normal taunt animation.

steps.text: As a Heavy in Mann vs. Machine, upgrade your primary weapon with Rage.
Fill the Rage meter. When a bomb carrier reaches the drop-off point and starts arming, taunt to activate Rage and push the robot.

achievements.description: As a Medic, share your canteen 5 times in a single wave.
achievements.summary: As a Medic in Mann vs. Machine, give your canteen effect to a teammate 5 times in one wave.

guide.context: A canteen holds only three charges, so refill it at least once during the wave.

steps.text: As a Medic in Mann vs. Machine, carry ÜberCharge or Crit Boost canteens.
Heal a teammate and use the canteen to share its effect with them. Do this 5 times in one wave.

achievements.description: As a Demoman, kill 10 robots in a single detonation.
achievements.summary: As a Demoman in Mann vs. Machine, kill 10 robots with one detonation.

steps.text: As a Demoman in Mann vs. Machine, lay a sticky trap where robots gather.
Detonate it once enough robots are on top of it. A Medic with a @item{Kritzkrieg} can help you place critical Stickybombs over a wide area.

achievements.description: As a Scout, use the Sandman to mark 15 robots for death in a single wave.
achievements.summary: As a Scout in Mann vs. Machine, mark 15 robots for death with the Sandman in one wave.

steps.text: As a Scout in Mann vs. Machine, buy the Mark For Death upgrade for the @item{Sandman}.
Mark robots by striking them with the Sandman or throwing its ball. Throw the ball from a distance when a group is too risky to approach.
Recollect used balls and upgrade ball ammo. Hits on the same robot all count, so keep going until you have 15 marks in one wave.

achievements.description: As a Sniper, kill 4 robots simultaneously.
achievements.summary: As a Sniper in Mann vs. Machine, kill 4 robots at the same time.

steps.text: As a Sniper in Mann vs. Machine, buy projectile penetration or explosive headshots for your primary weapon.
With penetration, also upgrade damage so a body shot destroys a robot.
Shoot along a line of robots, such as a swarm of Scouts or the Medics gathered around a giant.

achievements.description: As a Pyro, reset the bomb 3 times in a single wave.
achievements.summary: As a Pyro in Mann vs. Machine, reset the bomb 3 times during one wave.

guide.context: When a reset works, the Administrator reacts with an excited line. The bomb need not go all the way back.

steps.text: As a Pyro in Mann vs. Machine, use the compression blast on a bomb carrier to launch it off the robots' path, which is marked by blue arrows.
Launching it off a ledge, off a bridge or into a Coal Town mineshaft works well. Repeat until you have done it 3 times in one wave.

achievements.description: As an Engineer, escape with your sentry as a sentry buster is about to detonate.
achievements.summary: As an Engineer in Mann vs. Machine, carry your sentry gun away from a Sentry Buster that is about to blow up.

guide.context: The Sentry Buster crouches and arms itself before it explodes. The @item{Rescue Ranger} lets you pull out the sentry gun without standing near the blast.

steps.text: As an Engineer in Mann vs. Machine, wait for a @enemy{Sentry Buster} to reach your sentry gun and start arming.
During the arming, pick up the sentry gun and carry it out of the blast zone.

achievements.description: Get to Skull Island and claim your reward!
achievements.summary: Reach Skull Island through the portal Merasmus leaves behind and claim the reward.

guide.context: You do not have to help kill Merasmus. Enemy players may attack you at the island. Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: After Merasmus is defeated, enter the red portal he leaves behind before it closes.
Climb the stairs into the room and wait for the cage to come down.
Jump into the hat to claim the reward.

achievements.description: Kill MERASMUS!
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Merasmus}.

guide.context: When he bombards the Control Point, all attacks on him are Critical hits. Ranged classes such as Soldier and Sniper can avoid his melee strikes. Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: When Merasmus appears, attack him within his 90 seconds on the map. Both teams cannot hurt each other during this time.
If two players get bombs on their heads after he teleports, have them run into him to stun him.
At 50% and 10% health he turns into a prop. Spread out and hit props until one bleeds green blood, then keep attacking it.

achievements.description: Get and use a rare spell
achievements.summary: Get a rare spell and use it on Helltower.

guide.context: Rare spells also come from killing the Skeleton King and spawn at set places in Hell. Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: On Helltower, wait until it is 12 o'clock. Two white bridges appear near the cliff.
Walk over a bridge and go through the door at its end to receive a rare spell. Watch out for enemy fire.
Use the spell.

achievements.description: Win 142 rounds
achievements.summary: Win 142 rounds on Helltower.

guide.context: Only the team that wins in Hell gets credit. Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: Keep playing Helltower. Make sure your team is the one that wins in Hell, since only that team gets credit.

achievements.description: Perform 17 environmental kills in Hell
achievements.summary: Get 17 environmental kills in Hell on Helltower.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: After the round ends, change to a class that has knockback, such as the Pyro.
Once both teams are in Hell, push enemies into the lava.
You can also shoot exploding pumpkins when enemies are near them. Keep going until you reach 17.

achievements.description: Kill 99 skeletons
achievements.summary: Kill 99 skeletons on Helltower.

guide.context: All kinds of skeletons count. Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: On Helltower, hunt the green-tinted skeletons that spawn during every other Witching Hour.
Keep killing skeletons until you reach 99. Skeletons from an enemy's Summon Skeleton spell count too.

achievements.description: Use spells to kill 25 players
achievements.summary: Use spells to kill 25 players on Helltower.

guide.context: Spells lie around the map in the Witching Hour, drop from dead opponents, show up while the cart moves, and come from the Skeleton King. Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: On Helltower, pick up Magic Spells as often as you can.
Use the spells on enemy players until you have killed 25 with them.

achievements.description: Earn 4 of the Helltower achievements
achievements.summary: Earn any 4 Helltower achievements other than Helltower: Hat Out of Hell.

guide.context: The milestone unlocks by itself when you earn the fourth.

steps.text: Earn four of these: Helltower: Hell's Spells, Helltower: Spelling Spree, Helltower: Mine Games, Helltower: Skeleton Coup, Helltower: Hell on Wheels or Helltower: Competitive Spirit.

achievements.description: Get the loot from Skull Island in Hell
achievements.summary: Claim the Skull Island loot in Hell on Helltower.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: On Helltower, play until a team pushes the payload to the end and both teams are taken to Hell.
Head for the gate on the edge of Hell, even if your team lost. Fight off anyone in the way.
When the gate opens, climb the stairs and leap into the cage.

achievements.description: Send Redmond/Blutarch to Hell 10 times
achievements.summary: Be riding the cart's elevator when your team wins the round on Helltower, 10 times.

guide.context: Only works while the Halloween event is running.

steps.text: On Helltower, ride the cart's elevator when your team wins the round.
Pick a class that survives the ride, such as the Heavy, or use Soldier or Demoman explosive jumps to reach your teammates. Repeat until you reach 10.

achievements.description: Win 139 Rounds.
achievements.summary: Win 139 rounds on Standin.

steps.text: Keep playing Standin and winning rounds until you reach 139 wins.

achievements.description: Win 140 Rounds.
achievements.summary: Win 140 rounds on Process.

steps.text: Keep playing Process and winning rounds until you reach 140 wins.

achievements.description: Win 141 Rounds.
achievements.summary: Win 141 rounds on Snakewater.

steps.text: Keep playing Snakewater and winning rounds until you reach 141 wins.

achievements.description: Win a round in which the enemy team has attempted to capture your final control point.
achievements.summary: Win a Snakewater round in which the other team already tried to take your last control point.

steps.text: Play Snakewater and hold on until the other team has made a try at your last control point.
Push back and win the round.

achievements.description: Wipe the other team with 12 or more players on the server.
achievements.summary: Kill the whole enemy team on Snakewater while 12 or more players are on the server.

guide.context: The wipe must happen during the round, not during Humiliation.

steps.text: Play Snakewater on a server with at least 12 players.
Have your team kill every player on the enemy team during the round. The Administrator announces a successful team kill.

achievements.description: While rocket jumping, use a rocket to kill a rocket jumping enemy who also kills you with a rocket.
achievements.summary: While rocket jumping, kill a rocket jumping enemy with a rocket as they kill you with a rocket.

guide.context: Splash damage can work too if you are both near a wall.

steps.text: Play as a Soldier on Snakewater and rocket jump toward an enemy Soldier who is rocket jumping.
Hit each other with rockets so that both of you die. A @item{Direct Hit}, a critical rocket or low health makes this easier.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies in the rafters above the central capture point.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies standing in the rafters over the center control point on Snakewater.

steps.text: On Snakewater, look up for enemies in the rafters over the center point.
Kill them as a Scout, Soldier or Demoman, or snipe them from far away as a Sniper, until you have 15.

achievements.description: Kill a tank before it crashes through the barrier in Rottenburg.
achievements.summary: Destroy a tank in Mann vs. Machine on Rottenburg before it crashes through the barrier.

steps.text: On Rottenburg in Mann vs. Machine, use damage upgrades and crit boosts to take down a tank fast. Soldiers, Demomen and Pyros are good against tanks.
Try the last wave of the Intermediate mission: it sends 3 tanks with fairly low health.

achievements.description: Play an advanced wave in Rottenburg without the bomb entering the town.
achievements.summary: Finish an advanced Mann vs. Machine wave on Rottenburg with the bomb never getting into the town.

steps.text: Play an advanced wave of Mann vs. Machine on Rottenburg.
Keep the barrier standing, since this makes the robots travel farther.
Stop every bomb carrier before it gets into the town.

achievements.description: As a team, pit 10 robots in a single wave in Mannhattan.
achievements.summary: As a team, pit 10 robots in a single wave in Mann vs. Machine on Mannhattan.

steps.text: On Mannhattan in Mann vs. Machine, go to the pit with rotating sawblades near the first gate's exit.
Work as a team to push 10 robots into it in one wave. A good time is right after Gate A is captured, when robots are not moving.
A Pyro compression blast or a Heavy knockback upgrade is the best way to push them.

achievements.description: Ooohh Ooh Ahh Ahhhh! ...in Mannhattan
achievements.summary: Make a robot slip on the banana peel into the grinder in Mann vs. Machine on Mannhattan.

guide.context: You can let a robot pass on purpose to try this. An aggressive robot may step on the banana by itself if you overshoot.

steps.text: On Mannhattan in Mann vs. Machine, look for the grinder with a banana peel lying by it.
Push a robot onto the banana with knockback, for example the Pyro's compression blast, so it slides into the grinder.

achievements.description: Play an advanced mission without losing a single gate in Mannhattan.
achievements.summary: Play an advanced Mann vs. Machine mission on Mannhattan without losing a gate.

steps.text: On Mannhattan in an advanced Mann vs. Machine mission, defend both gates and destroy every robot trying to capture them.
Have a Medic buy the projectile shield upgrade to deflect incoming projectiles.

achievements.description: As a team, kill 50 stunned radiowave robots in an advanced mission in Mannhattan.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 stunned radiowave robots as a team in an advanced mission on Mannhattan in Mann vs. Machine.

guide.context: Kills by any teammate count toward the 50.

steps.text: Start an advanced Mannhattan mission in Mann vs. Machine with your team.
When a robot captures a gate, kill the stunned robots around it. Giant robots stay active, so have one teammate draw their attention.

achievements.description: Kill 500 gate crashing robots in Mannhattan.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 robots that are capturing gates on Mannhattan in Mann vs. Machine.

steps.text: Play Mann vs. Machine missions on Mannhattan.
Kill robots while they capture the gates. Keep playing until the total reaches 500.

achievements.description: Kill 5 robots in a single explosion from detonating a sentry buster.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 robots with the explosion of one Sentry Buster in Mann vs. Machine.

steps.text: As an Engineer in Mann vs. Machine, pick up your sentry gun when a @enemy{Sentry Buster} comes for it.
Run the @enemy{Sentry Buster} into a group of robots, drop the sentry gun, and let it explode there.

achievements.description: Pit 100 robots in Rottenburg.
achievements.summary: Knock 100 robots into a bottomless pit on Rottenburg in Mann vs. Machine.

guide.context: The two pits are the Disposal Shaft on the lower route through Town Square and the river by the Medic Workshop.

steps.text: Play Mann vs. Machine missions on Rottenburg.
Use knockback on robots standing next to a pit, such as the Pyro compression blast or the Heavy knockback upgrade.

achievements.description: As a Sniper collect $500 in a mission without running over the currency packs.
achievements.summary: As a Sniper in a Mann vs. Machine mission on Mannhattan, collect $500 without running over currency packs.

guide.context: Money from headshot kills counts as already collected, so do not run over those packs yourself.

steps.text: Play Sniper in a Mann vs. Machine mission on Mannhattan and buy the Explosive Headshot upgrade for your primary weapon.
Kill robots with headshots, or with the Explosive Headshot blast on robots next to your target, until you have collected $500 in one mission.

achievements.description: Block 5,000 damage with the shield as a Medic in a single life.
achievements.summary: As a Medic in Mann vs. Machine, absorb 5,000 points of damage on the Medi Gun shield during one life.

steps.text: Play Medic in a Mann vs. Machine mission and upgrade the shield on the Medi Gun.
Stand where rockets and grenades land on your shield, such as corridors or against robot Soldiers and Demomen, until 5,000 damage is absorbed and you have not died.

achievements.description: Use one ÜberCharge to quickly revive 2 teammates within 5 seconds.
achievements.summary: Use one ÜberCharge to revive 2 teammates within 5 seconds in Mann vs. Machine.

guide.context: The Healing Mastery upgrade helps, and the Quick-Fix revives teammates faster than any other Medi Gun.

steps.text: As a Medic in Mann vs. Machine, wait until two teammates are down close to each other.
Use your ÜberCharge and revive both of them within 5 seconds.

achievements.description: Kill 5 robots with a single rocket while upgraded with rocket specialist.
achievements.summary: As a Soldier upgraded with Rocket Specialist, kill 5 robots with a single rocket in Mann vs. Machine.

steps.text: As a Soldier in Mann vs. Machine, buy the Rocket Specialist upgrade.
Fire a rocket at a tight group of robots. A crit boost makes the splash damage kill most standard robots.

achievements.description: Stun 50 robots while upgraded with rocket specialist.
achievements.summary: As a Soldier upgraded with Rocket Specialist, stun 50 robots in Mann vs. Machine.

steps.text: As a Soldier in Mann vs. Machine, buy the Rocket Specialist upgrade.
Hit robots with rockets from close range. Giant robots are easy targets to stun.

achievements.description: Kill 10 parachuting players.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 players who are parachuting.

guide.context: The B.A.S.E. Jumper lets its user cancel the parachute, so high instant damage works best.

steps.text: Look for an enemy Soldier or Demoman with an open parachute.
Fire upward and kill each one before they land.

achievements.description: Melee kill 10 Snipers using The Classic.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Snipers who are using The Classic with melee attacks.

steps.text: Find an enemy Sniper holding The Classic.
Sneak up on the Sniper while he is aiming and kill him with a melee weapon.

achievements.description: Kill a charging Demoman.
achievements.summary: Kill a Demoman while he is charging.

guide.context: Scattergun, Minigun and Sniper Rifle shots hurt him without stopping the charge.

steps.text: Dodge the charge of an enemy Demoman and shoot him while he charges.

achievements.description: While using the Back Scatter, kill 20 spies from behind.
achievements.summary: As a Scout, kill 20 Spies with shots to the back while wielding the Back Scatter.

steps.text: Take the Back Scatter out as a Scout.
Fire into the back of Spies. To find a disguised Spy, run up behind a teammate and fire a few bursts.

achievements.description: While using the Back Scatter, kill a Heavy/Medic pair within 20 seconds of each other.
achievements.summary: With the Back Scatter out, kill one Heavy and one Medic no more than 20 seconds apart.

steps.text: Take out the Back Scatter and sneak up behind an enemy Heavy and Medic pair near the front line.
Kill the Medic first, then the Heavy before 20 seconds pass.

achievements.description: While using the Back Scatter, kill 20 friends from behind.
achievements.summary: With the Back Scatter out, shoot 20 friends in the back to kill them.

guide.context: Kills powered by Fan O'War or Crit-a-Cola mini-crits count too.

steps.text: Get your friends onto the opposing team, for example on a server they play on.
Take out the Back Scatter and shoot friends in the back until you have 20 kills.

achievements.description: While using The Classic, kill 10 enemies with a full charge, no-scope headshot.
achievements.summary: With The Classic out, get 10 headshot kills at full charge without scoping in.

steps.text: Take out The Classic and hold fire to build a full charge without opening the scope.
Aim at the head and release at full charge. Stay near the front line, and begin charging as you step out of cover.

achievements.description: While using The Classic, kill a rocket/grenade jumping enemy in midair with a full charge, no-scope headshot.
achievements.summary: With The Classic out, shoot a rocket-jumping or grenade-jumping enemy dead in midair using a full-charge unscoped headshot.

steps.text: Take out The Classic and charge a shot to full without scoping.
Hit an enemy who is jumping with rockets or grenades while he is airborne. The peak of the jump is the best moment.
An enemy floating under a parachute is even easier to hit.

achievements.description: While using The Classic, gib all 9 classes during a single round.
achievements.summary: With The Classic out, gib a player of every class (all 9) within one round.

guide.context: A Classic shot gibs if the final blow deals at least the victim's remaining health plus 10, or if it is a mini-crit or crit, headshots included. Scope use has no effect.

steps.text: Take out The Classic in a mode with long rounds, such as Capture the Flag.
Gib one player of each of the 9 classes before the round ends.

achievements.description: Kill 3 players during the same parachute deploy.
achievements.summary: As a Soldier, get 3 kills before landing from a single parachute deploy.

steps.text: Bring the B.A.S.E. Jumper in your loadout.
Float down over a cluster of enemies and take 3 kills before you touch the ground.

achievements.description: Parachute 19.47 miles.
achievements.summary: As a Soldier, parachute a total of 19.47 miles.

steps.text: Bring the B.A.S.E. Jumper and open it for long falls until your total distance reaches 19.47 miles.

achievements.description: Kill a parachuting player while parachuting.
achievements.summary: As a Soldier, kill a parachuting player while you are parachuting.

guide.context: The enemy must be parachuting too: a Soldier or Demoman who has deployed a B.A.S.E. Jumper.

steps.text: Bring the B.A.S.E. Jumper. An enemy Soldier or Demoman must have a B.A.S.E. Jumper open as well.
Once you and that enemy are both airborne, aim at him. Splash damage is unreliable in the air, so go for direct hits.

achievements.description: Kill 3 players during the same parachute deploy.
achievements.summary: As a Demoman, get 3 kills before landing from one parachute deploy.

steps.text: Put the B.A.S.E. Jumper in your primary slot and the Stickybomb Launcher in your secondary slot.
Launch yourself high over an enemy group with a sticky jump, open the parachute, and take 3 kills before touchdown.

achievements.description: Parachute 19.47 miles.
achievements.summary: As a Demoman, parachute a total of 19.47 miles.

steps.text: Bring the B.A.S.E. Jumper and open it for long falls until your total distance reaches 19.47 miles.

achievements.description: Kill a parachuting player while parachuting.
achievements.summary: As a Demoman, kill a parachuting player while you are parachuting.

steps.text: Bring the B.A.S.E. Jumper. An enemy Soldier or Demoman must be parachuting too.
Sticky jump toward the enemy, then use Stickybombs detonated in midair or your melee weapon.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy that you couldn't see at the beginning of your charge.
achievements.summary: As a Demoman, kill an enemy you could not see when your charge began.

steps.text: Hold position in a tight corridor where you cannot see far, and charge when you think an enemy will come around.
Or use the Tide Turner to steer your charge in the open.

achievements.description: Get 3 kills within 6 seconds using the Demoman charge.
achievements.summary: As a Demoman, charge into 3 kills inside a 6-second window.

guide.context: A separate route that does not use the charge: kill three players with a single Ullapool Caber melee attack.

steps.text: Equip the Tide Turner, which makes three charges in 6 seconds realistic.
Charge three times in a row and get a kill each time. Look for the next enemy before each kill.

achievements.description: Kill a charging Demoman while charging.
achievements.summary: As a Demoman, kill a charging Demoman while you are charging.

guide.context: Swinging a melee weapon ends your charge and the kill will not count.

steps.text: Find a Demoman charging away at low health, for example toward a health pack.
Charge at him and kill him with a shield bash. Do not swing a melee weapon.

achievements.description: Backstab a Scout that is using the Back Scatter.
achievements.summary: As a Spy, backstab a Scout who is using the Back Scatter.

steps.text: Find an enemy Scout with a Back Scatter and watch the routes he uses to reach your team.
Backstab him.

achievements.description: Collect enough casualties to get the max clip for the Air Strike.
achievements.summary: As a Soldier, get enough kills with the Air Strike to raise its clip to the maximum.

guide.context: The Air Strike clip starts at 4 and grows by 1 for each kill, up to 8.

steps.text: Take the Air Strike and a B.A.S.E. Jumper with you.
Get 4 kills with the Air Strike in one life, so the clip grows from 4 to 8.

achievements.description: Kill 3 people with the Air Strike during a single rocket jump.
achievements.summary: As a Soldier, take down 3 players with the Air Strike during one rocket jump.

steps.text: Take the Air Strike and a B.A.S.E. Jumper with you, then rocket jump toward a cluster of enemies.
Fire at tightly grouped enemies while you are in the air.

achievements.description: Kill 25 parachuting players with a critical headshot.
achievements.summary: As a Sniper, kill 25 players who are parachuting with critical headshots.

steps.text: Find enemies with an open parachute, such as Soldiers and Demomen.
Predict their path and land a critical headshot on each one.

achievements.description: Kill 3 players who are doing the Conga within 5 seconds.
achievements.summary: Take out 3 Conga dancers inside a 5-second window.

steps.text: Find a group of 3 or more players doing the Conga.
Kill three of them inside a 5-second window.

achievements.description: Do the Conga with 10 or more players at the same time.
achievements.summary: Be part of a Conga with at least 10 players dancing together.

steps.text: Join a player doing the Conga.
Wait for others, from any team, to join until 10 players are doing the Conga.

achievements.description: Lose at Rock, Paper, Scissors 3 times in a row with Rock.
achievements.summary: Lose 3 games of Rock, Paper, Scissors in a row with Rock.

guide.context: The game picks each hand at random, so you cannot choose Rock. Keep playing until the streak happens.

steps.text: Use the Rock, Paper, Scissors taunt with another player. Repeat it until you lose three games in a row with Rock.

achievements.description: Win at Rock, Paper, Scissors 3 times in a row with Scissors.
achievements.summary: Win 3 games of Rock, Paper, Scissors in a row with Scissors.

guide.context: The game picks each hand at random, so you cannot choose Scissors. Keep playing until the streak happens.

steps.text: Use the Rock, Paper, Scissors taunt with another player. Repeat it until you win three games in a row with Scissors.

achievements.description: Melee kill 10 players while they are doing the Square Dance taunt.
achievements.summary: Melee-kill 10 players who are in the middle of the Square Dance taunt.

steps.text: Find players doing the Square Dance taunt, ideally a group.
Kill them with a melee weapon. A Spy backstab is an easy way.

achievements.description: Do 10 partner taunts with a teammate while capturing a control point.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 partner taunts alongside a teammate while you capture a control point.

steps.text: While you capture a control point with a teammate and no enemies are near, start a partner taunt.
Repeat until you have done 10.

achievements.description: Ignite a player that is being flipped by someone using the Flippin' Awesome taunt.
achievements.summary: As a Pyro, set fire to a player who is mid-flip from another player's Flippin' Awesome taunt.

steps.text: Wait until a player starts the Flippin' Awesome taunt.
Set fire to the player being flipped, not the one who began the taunt. Use the Flare Gun if you cannot get close.

achievements.description: Kill 30 enemies by bumping their bumper cars off the tracks.
achievements.summary: Bump 30 enemy bumper cars off the tracks to kill them.

guide.context: Bumper car games run during the Halloween event, or on community servers that use Halloween maps.

steps.text: Ram enemy cars to push up their damage percentage and send them back.
Avoid head-on hits, which throw both cars back. Use the boost and spells to shove cars off the track.

achievements.displayName: Carnival of Carnage: Up All Night To Get Ducky
achievements.description: Collect 250 ducks.
achievements.summary: Collect 250 ducks in bumper car games.

guide.context: Bumper car games run during the Halloween event, or on community servers that use Halloween maps.

steps.text: Drive over ducks in the bumper car games. They appear first in the middle and then switch between the sides and the middle.
Bumping an enemy drops more ducks, based on the damage dealt.

achievements.description: Score 3 goals in bumper car soccer.
achievements.summary: Put 3 goals in during bumper car soccer.

guide.context: Bumper car games run during the Halloween event, or on community servers that use Halloween maps.

steps.text: Push the ball into the enemy goal together with your team. You need to be the final player to touch it.
Pass the ball, block enemies with teammates, and rush the goal after the enemy scores.

achievements.description: Respawn 30 ghost teammates during bumper car games.
achievements.summary: Bring 30 ghost teammates back to life during bumper car games.

guide.context: Bumper car games run during the Halloween event, or on community servers that use Halloween maps.

steps.text: Stay alive in bumper car games so your ghost teammates can respawn.
The falling platforms game has the most casualties.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies while under the effect of Merasmus's melee-only curse.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies while under Merasmus's melee-only curse.

guide.context: Bumper car games run during the Halloween event, or on community servers that use Halloween maps. Kills made while shrunk by the shrinking spell also count.

steps.text: Take melee kills while the melee-only curse is on you. It also makes you run faster.
Pick a class with a good melee weapon, such as Demoman.

achievements.displayName: Carnival of Carnage: Step Right Up
achievements.description: Earn 4 of the Carnival of Carnage achievements.
achievements.summary: Unlock any four Carnival of Carnage achievements.

steps.text: Earn any 4 of the other Carnival of Carnage achievements. This one then unlocks by itself.

achievements.displayName: Carnival of Carnage: Bumper to Bumper to Bumper
achievements.description: Win each of the 3 bumper car games to earn a bonus Halloween Gift Cauldron.
achievements.summary: Win all three kinds of bumper car game at least once.

guide.context: Bumper car games run during the Halloween event, or on community servers that use Halloween maps.

steps.text: Take one victory in each of the three bumper car game types.
Deliver tickets before a game so the other team starts at 66%.

achievements.description: Win 142 Rounds.
achievements.summary: Win 142 rounds on Powerhouse.

steps.text: Play on Powerhouse and keep winning rounds until you reach 142 wins.

achievements.description: Win a round in which the enemy team has attempted to capture your final control point.
achievements.summary: Win a round on Powerhouse after the enemy team has tried to capture your final control point.

steps.text: Play on Powerhouse. After the enemy team starts to capture your last point, push them back and win the round.

achievements.description: Capture the final control point within 15 seconds of your team capturing the previous control point.
achievements.summary: On Powerhouse, take the last control point no more than 15 seconds after your team took the one before it.

steps.text: Assign one or two players to capture the middle point while everyone else clears out the last point.
Take the last point within 15 seconds. If the enemy counterattacks, a Scout or Spy can sneak around behind them.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies while they are capturing a point.
achievements.summary: On Powerhouse, kill 15 enemies in the middle of capturing a point.

steps.text: Go after enemies standing on the middle point or on your last point.

achievements.description: Kill five enemies while they are in the water.
achievements.summary: On Powerhouse, kill 5 enemies standing in water.

guide.context: The Neon Annihilator may make this easier.

steps.text: Shoot enemies that wade or get knocked into the water between the two bases. They have little room to dodge there.

achievements.description: Reveal the mystery of the PASS Time TV Room.
achievements.summary: On Brickyard in PASS Time, with 9 players on their marks, shoot out the plug behind the television so it glows green.

guide.context: This needs 9 players working together, so arrange a group before you start.

steps.text: Play PASS Time on Brickyard with 5 players on RED and 4 players on BLU.
A RED player stands on the Engineer's guitar in the small area left of the RED goal when facing it, next to the Destruction PDA.
A hidden goal appears on the BLU side. Throw the Jack into it. Make sure no spectator stands or floats in the TV room area, or the unlock can fail.
In each spawn room, the doors marked "PRIVATE" open. Walk into your team's Teleporter to reach the TV room.
Nine marks surround the TV. Count them from the left: mark 1 RED Pyro, mark 2 BLU Spy, mark 3 RED Sniper, mark 4 RED Medic.
Then mark 5 BLU Engineer, mark 6 RED Heavy, mark 7 RED Soldier, mark 8 BLU Demoman, mark 9 BLU Scout. Everyone must stand squarely on their mark.
Shoot out the plug behind the television. The television glows green.

achievements.description: Win 10 rounds playing PASS Time.
achievements.summary: Win 10 rounds of PASS Time.

guide.context: Only rounds you join from the opening of setup time through to the end count.

steps.text: Join a PASS Time round at the start of setup time and stay until the round ends.
Repeat until you have won 10 rounds.
